4721impl AbortFinalizingStream {
4722    /// Fail-closed relay abort: the client connection is severed (the
4723    /// status line already went out, so a clean error response is no
4724    /// longer possible). Without this log the reason would vanish into
4725    /// an io::Error that hyper discards — leaving "empty reply from
4726    /// server" as the only symptom of e.g. an upstream returning HTML.
4727    fn abort_error(&self, reason: String) -> std::io::Error {
4728        tracing::warn!(
4729            session = %self.session.id,
4730            %reason,
4731            "aborting client response; upstream reply could not be captured"
4732        );
4733        std::io::Error::other(reason)
4734    }
4735
4736    /// Scope a mid-stream capture
4737    /// failure to THIS response instead of sealing the whole session.
4738    /// The failure reason is recorded into the audit trail via
4739    /// `submit_response_capture(Some(_))` (at-most-once), so the turn
4740    /// is attested as failed and the session stays usable for future
4741    /// turns — a transient provider framing quirk no longer costs the
4742    /// operator every previously-captured turn. Only when the audit
4743    /// worker itself cannot accept the capture do we fall back to
4744    /// sealing the session: without the failure record the audit chain
4745    /// has a hole no later close could explain.
4746    fn record_response_failure(&mut self, reason: &str) {
4747        // StopReason::Other, not BudgetExceeded: this path carries
4748        // network cuts, garbled provider frames, and flush failures —
4749        // none of them enforcement. Attesting them as "Budget
4750        // Exceeded" (verified live: a provider-side TCP RST
4751        // mid-stream journalled stop_reason_id 92) tells a compliance
4752        // reviewer the harness cut the turn off when the provider
4753        // crashed. Only the genuine mid-stream budget refusal passes
4754        // BudgetExceeded (see the pending-budget Refused arm).
4755        if let Err(error) =
4756            self.submit_response_capture(Some((pv_events::StopReason::Other, reason.to_owned())))
4757        {
4758            tracing::warn!(
4759                %error,
4760                session = %self.session.id,
4761                "response-failure capture submit failed; sealing session capture"
4762            );
4763            self.session.mark_capture_failed();
4764        }
4765    }
4766}
4767
4768/// How far back an incremental egress scan starts before the bytes it
4769/// has not seen yet, so a match that straddles two frames is still
4770/// found. A pattern is at most 512 bytes; a match longer than this is
4771/// caught by the full rescan at the end of the body.
4772const EGRESS_SCAN_OVERLAP: usize = 1024;
4773
4774/// The part of `text` an incremental egress scan looks at: everything
4775/// from [`EGRESS_SCAN_OVERLAP`] bytes before the already-scanned length,
4776/// on a character boundary.
4777fn scan_window(text: &str, scanned: usize) -> &str {
4778    let mut start = scanned.saturating_sub(EGRESS_SCAN_OVERLAP).min(text.len());
4779    while start > 0 && !text.is_char_boundary(start) {
4780        start -= 1;
4781    }
4782    text.get(start..).unwrap_or_default()
4783}
4784
4785impl AbortFinalizingStream {
4786    /// The first console-pushed egress guardrail that refuses the text
4787    /// captured so far, as `(policy, reason)`. Scans only what arrived
4788    /// since the last call (plus [`EGRESS_SCAN_OVERLAP`]); `full`
4789    /// rescans everything, which the end-of-body check uses.
4790    fn egress_refusal(&mut self, full: bool) -> Option<(String, String)> {
4791        if !self.pushed.inspects_responses() {
4792            return None;
4793        }
4794        for (index, capture) in &self.response_choices {
4795            let scanned = if full {
4796                0
4797            } else {
4798                self.egress_scanned.get(index).copied().unwrap_or(0)
4799            };
4800            let mut start = scanned
4801                .saturating_sub(EGRESS_SCAN_OVERLAP)
4802                .min(capture.content.len());
4803            while start > 0 && !capture.content.is_char_boundary(start) {
4804                start -= 1;
4805            }
4806            let window = capture.content.get(start..).unwrap_or_default();
4807            if let Some(hit) = self.pushed.refuses_response(window) {
4808                return Some(hit);
4809            }
4810            self.egress_scanned.insert(*index, capture.content.len());
4811        }
4812        // Reasoning text and tool-call arguments are scanned the same
4813        // way: a model can leak through either.
4814        for (index, capture) in &self.response_choices {
4815            let scanned = if full {
4816                0
4817            } else {
4818                self.egress_scanned_reasoning.get(index).copied().unwrap_or(0)
4819            };
4820            let window = scan_window(&capture.reasoning, scanned);
4821            if let Some(hit) = self.pushed.refuses_response_part(window, "reasoning") {
4822                return Some(hit);
4823            }
4824            self.egress_scanned_reasoning
4825                .insert(*index, capture.reasoning.len());
4826        }
4827        for (key, call) in &self.response_tool_calls {
4828            let scanned = if full {
4829                0
4830            } else {
4831                self.egress_scanned_tools.get(key).copied().unwrap_or(0)
4832            };
4833            let window = scan_window(&call.arguments, scanned);
4834            if let Some(hit) = self.pushed.refuses_response_part(window, "tool call") {
4835                return Some(hit);
4836            }
4837            self.egress_scanned_tools.insert(*key, call.arguments.len());
4838        }
4839        None
4840    }
4841
4842    /// Apply the console-pushed `llm.egress` transforms to the captured
4843    /// response (content, reasoning, tool-call arguments) and to the
4844    /// bytes about to be relayed, so the journal and the client see the
4845    /// same rewritten text. Called once, when the response is complete.
4846    fn apply_egress_transforms(&mut self) {
4847        if !self.pushed.rewrites_responses() {
4848            return;
4849        }
4850        let mut applied: std::collections::BTreeMap<String, usize> = std::collections::BTreeMap::new();
4851        let mut note = |hits: Vec<(String, usize)>| {
4852            for (policy, count) in hits {
4853                *applied.entry(policy).or_insert(0) += count;
4854            }
4855        };
4856        for capture in self.response_choices.values_mut() {
4857            note(self.pushed.rewrite_response_text(&mut capture.content));
4858            note(self.pushed.rewrite_response_text(&mut capture.reasoning));
4859        }
4860        for call in self.response_tool_calls.values_mut() {
4861            note(self.pushed.rewrite_response_text(&mut call.arguments));
4862        }
4863        if applied.is_empty() {
4864            return;
4865        }
4866        self.egress_transforms = applied.into_iter().collect();
4867        for (policy, replacements) in &self.egress_transforms {
4868            tracing::info!(
4869                session = %self.session.id,
4870                %policy,
4871                replacements,
4872                "model response rewritten by a console-pushed transform"
4873            );
4874        }
4875        if self.is_sse {
4876            self.rewrite_held_frames();
4877        } else {
4878            self.rewrite_buffered_body();
4879        }
4880    }
4881
4882    /// Rewrite the buffered (non-streaming) body held in
4883    /// `pending_output` with the rewritten captures.
4884    fn rewrite_buffered_body(&mut self) {
4885        let mut raw = Vec::new();
4886        for chunk in &self.pending_output {
4887            raw.extend_from_slice(chunk);
4888        }
4889        let Ok(mut body) = serde_json::from_slice::<Value>(&raw) else {
4890            return;
4891        };
4892        let Some(choices) = body.get_mut("choices").and_then(Value::as_array_mut) else {
4893            return;
4894        };
4895        for (position, choice) in choices.iter_mut().enumerate() {
4896            let index = choice
4897                .get("index")
4898                .and_then(Value::as_u64)
4899                .or_else(|| u64::try_from(position).ok())
4900                .unwrap_or(u64::MAX);
4901            let Some(capture) = self.response_choices.get(&index) else {
4902                continue;
4903            };
4904            if let Some(content) = choice.pointer_mut("/message/content") {
4905                if content.is_string() {
4906                    *content = Value::String(capture.content.clone());
4907                } else if let Some(parts) = content.as_array_mut() {
4908                    for part in parts {
4909                        if let Some(text) = part.get_mut("text").and_then(|t| t.as_str().map(str::to_owned)) {
4910                            let mut text = text;
4911                            self.pushed.rewrite_response_text(&mut text);
4912                            part["text"] = Value::String(text);
4913                        }
4914                    }
4915                }
4916            }
4917            if let Some(reasoning) = choice.pointer_mut("/message/reasoning_content") {
4918                if reasoning.is_string() {
4919                    *reasoning = Value::String(capture.reasoning.clone());
4920                }
4921            }
4922            if let Some(calls) = choice
4923                .pointer_mut("/message/tool_calls")
4924                .and_then(Value::as_array_mut)
4925            {
4926                for (call_position, call) in calls.iter_mut().enumerate() {
4927                    let call_index = call
4928                        .get("index")
4929                        .and_then(Value::as_u64)
4930                        .or_else(|| u64::try_from(call_position).ok())
4931                        .unwrap_or(u64::MAX);
4932                    let rewritten = self
4933                        .response_tool_calls
4934                        .get(&(index, call_index))
4935                        .map(|partial| partial.arguments.clone());
4936                    if let (Some(rewritten), Some(arguments)) =
4937                        (rewritten, call.pointer_mut("/function/arguments"))
4938                    {
4939                        if arguments.is_string() {
4940                            *arguments = Value::String(rewritten);
4941                        }
4942                    }
4943                }
4944            }
4945        }
4946        if let Ok(bytes) = serde_json::to_vec(&body) {
4947            self.pending_output.clear();
4948            self.pending_output.push_back(Bytes::from(bytes));
4949        }
4950    }
4951
4952    /// Replace the held SSE frames with rewritten ones: the first frame
4953    /// that carries a choice's content gets the whole rewritten text and
4954    /// later content deltas become empty, so frame count, ids, finish
4955    /// reasons and usage stay as the provider sent them. Reasoning and
4956    /// tool-call arguments are handled the same way.
4957    fn rewrite_held_frames(&mut self) {
4958        let frames = std::mem::take(&mut self.held_frames);
4959        let mut content_done: std::collections::BTreeSet<u64> = std::collections::BTreeSet::new();
4960        let mut reasoning_done: std::collections::BTreeSet<u64> = std::collections::BTreeSet::new();
4961        let mut tools_done: std::collections::BTreeSet<(u64, u64)> = std::collections::BTreeSet::new();
4962        self.pending_output.clear();
4963        for frame in frames {
4964            let rewritten =
4965                self.rewrite_frame(&frame, &mut content_done, &mut reasoning_done, &mut tools_done);
4966            self.pending_output.push_back(Bytes::from(rewritten));
4967        }
4968    }
4969
4970    fn rewrite_frame(
4971        &self,
4972        frame: &str,
4973        content_done: &mut std::collections::BTreeSet<u64>,
4974        reasoning_done: &mut std::collections::BTreeSet<u64>,
4975        tools_done: &mut std::collections::BTreeSet<(u64, u64)>,
4976    ) -> String {
4977        // Only `data:` frames carrying a JSON object with choices are
4978        // rewritten; everything else (`[DONE]`, comments, usage-only
4979        // frames) is relayed verbatim.
4980        let mut data_lines = Vec::new();
4981        let mut other_lines = Vec::new();
4982        for line in frame.lines() {
4983            match line.strip_prefix("data:") {
4984                Some(rest) => data_lines.push(rest.trim_start().to_owned()),
4985                None => other_lines.push(line.to_owned()),
4986            }
4987        }
4988        if data_lines.is_empty() {
4989            return frame.to_owned();
4990        }
4991        let joined = data_lines.join("\n");
4992        let Ok(mut value) = serde_json::from_str::<Value>(&joined) else {
4993            return frame.to_owned();
4994        };
4995        let Some(choices) = value.get_mut("choices").and_then(Value::as_array_mut) else {
4996            return frame.to_owned();
4997        };
4998        for (position, choice) in choices.iter_mut().enumerate() {
4999            let index = choice
5000                .get("index")
5001                .and_then(Value::as_u64)
5002                .or_else(|| u64::try_from(position).ok())
5003                .unwrap_or(u64::MAX);
5004            if let Some(content) = choice.pointer_mut("/delta/content") {
5005                if content.as_str().is_some_and(|text| !text.is_empty()) {
5006                    *content = Value::String(if content_done.insert(index) {
5007                        self.response_choices
5008                            .get(&index)
5009                            .map(|c| c.content.clone())
5010                            .unwrap_or_default()
5011                    } else {
5012                        String::new()
5013                    });
5014                }
5015            }
5016            if let Some(reasoning) = choice.pointer_mut("/delta/reasoning_content") {
5017                if reasoning.as_str().is_some_and(|text| !text.is_empty()) {
5018                    *reasoning = Value::String(if reasoning_done.insert(index) {
5019                        self.response_choices
5020                            .get(&index)
5021                            .map(|c| c.reasoning.clone())
5022                            .unwrap_or_default()
5023                    } else {
5024                        String::new()
5025                    });
5026                }
5027            }
5028            if let Some(calls) = choice
5029                .pointer_mut("/delta/tool_calls")
5030                .and_then(Value::as_array_mut)
5031            {
5032                for call in calls.iter_mut() {
5033                    let Some(call_index) = call.get("index").and_then(Value::as_u64) else {
5034                        continue;
5035                    };
5036                    if let Some(arguments) = call.pointer_mut("/function/arguments") {
5037                        if arguments.as_str().is_some_and(|text| !text.is_empty()) {
5038                            *arguments = Value::String(if tools_done.insert((index, call_index)) {
5039                                self.response_tool_calls
5040                                    .get(&(index, call_index))
5041                                    .map(|partial| partial.arguments.clone())
5042                                    .unwrap_or_default()
5043                            } else {
5044                                String::new()
5045                            });
5046                        }
5047                    }
5048                }
5049            }
5050        }
5051        let mut out = String::new();
5052        for line in other_lines {
5053            out.push_str(&line);
5054            out.push('\n');
5055        }
5056        out.push_str("data: ");
5057        out.push_str(&value.to_string());
5058        out.push_str("\n\n");
5059        out
5060    }
5061
5062    /// Refuse the response for an egress guardrail hit: attest the turn
5063    /// as policy-blocked and attributed to the policy, drop any held
5064    /// output, and hand back the error the handler maps to HTTP 403.
5065    fn refuse_egress(&mut self, policy: String, reason: String) -> std::io::Error {
5066        tracing::warn!(
5067            session = %self.session.id,
5068            %policy,
5069            %reason,
5070            "model response refused by a console-pushed guardrail"
5071        );
5072        self.failure_policy = Some(policy);
5073        if let Err(error) =
5074            self.submit_response_capture(Some((pv_events::StopReason::PolicyBlocked, reason.clone())))
5075        {
5076            tracing::warn!(
5077                %error,
5078                session = %self.session.id,
5079                "guardrail refusal capture submit failed; sealing session capture"
5080            );
5081            self.session.mark_capture_failed();
5082        }
5083        self.pending_output.clear();
5084        std::io::Error::new(
5085            std::io::ErrorKind::PermissionDenied,
5086            format!("response blocked by guardrail: {reason}"),
5087        )
5088    }
5089
5090    /// The SSE form of [`Self::refuse_egress`]: before any byte reached
5091    /// the client the handler still turns the error into a real 403;
5092    /// after that the status line is committed, so the stream ends with
5093    /// an error frame the SDK surfaces, then EOF.
5094    fn refuse_sse_egress(
5095        &mut self,
5096        policy: String,
5097        reason: String,
5098    ) -> Poll<Option<Result<Bytes, std::io::Error>>> {
5099        let error = self.refuse_egress(policy, reason);
5100        if !self.emitted_any {
5101            return Poll::Ready(Some(Err(error)));
5102        }
5103        self.completed = true;
5104        let frame = format!(
5105            "data: {}\n\n",
5106            json!({"error": {"message": error.to_string(), "type": "policy_blocked", "code": "guardrail"}})
5107        );
5108        Poll::Ready(Some(Ok(Bytes::from(frame))))
5109    }
5110}
5111
5112impl Stream for AbortFinalizingStream {
5113    type Item = Result<Bytes, std::io::Error>;
5114
5115    fn poll_next(mut self: Pin<&mut Self>, context: &mut Context<'_>) -> Poll<Option<Self::Item>> {
5116        if self.pending_budget.is_some() {
5117            let result = {
5118                let Some(pending) = self.pending_budget.as_mut() else {
5119                    self.session.mark_capture_failed();
5120                    return Poll::Ready(Some(Err(std::io::Error::other(
5121                        "pending completion budget state disappeared",
5122                    ))));
5123                };
5124                match Pin::new(&mut pending.task).poll(context) {
5125                    Poll::Pending => return Poll::Pending,
5126                    Poll::Ready(result) => result,
5127                }
5128            };
5129            let Some(pending) = self.pending_budget.take() else {
5130                self.session.mark_capture_failed();
5131                return Poll::Ready(Some(Err(std::io::Error::other(
5132                    "completed completion budget state disappeared",
5133                ))));
5134            };
5135            let failure = match result {
5136                Ok(Ok(pv_state::BudgetDecision::Allowed { .. })) => None,
5137                Ok(Ok(pv_state::BudgetDecision::Refused { limit, cap })) => {
5138                    // The refused delta was never debited (check-and-spend
5139                    // refuses without spending; the principal side is
5140                    // refunded inside the task), but `absorb_frame` already
5141                    // folded it into `charged_completion_tokens` — roll it
5142                    // back or the terminal over-charge refund credits
5143                    // tokens that were never spent (drain-loop rollback
5144                    // invariant).
5145                    self.charged_completion_tokens =
5146                        self.charged_completion_tokens.saturating_sub(pending.delta);
5147                    // Genuine mid-stream cap exhaustion — the ONLY arm
5148                    // that latches. The Ok(Err(..)) arm below is the
5149                    // quota-backend outage (fail-closed refusal, not
5150                    // enforcement): latching it converted a transient
5151                    // store blip into a permanent id lockout, the exact
5152                    // defect the chat path's backend-error arm
5153                    // deliberately avoids.
5154                    self.session
5155                        .latch_enforcement(pv_events::StopReason::BudgetExceeded);
5156                    // Name the console policy that set the cap, as the
5157                    // admission-time check does, so the refusal and the
5158                    // stop-reason event attribute the block.
5159                    let policy = self.pushed.budget_policy_for(&self.local_budget, &limit, cap);
5160                    let reason = match &policy {
5161                        Some(name) => format!("policy {name:?}: {limit} exceeded (cap {cap})"),
5162                        None => format!("{limit} exceeded (cap {cap})"),
5163                    };
5164                    self.failure_policy = policy;
5165                    Some((pv_events::StopReason::BudgetExceeded, reason))
5166                }
5167                // Backend outage: fail-closed refusal, not enforcement —
5168                // attested Other, mirroring the no-latch decision above.
5169                // The session debit did not land (the task's error arm
5170                // refunds the principal side too) — same rollback as the
5171                // Refused arm.
5172                Ok(Err(reason)) => {
5173                    self.charged_completion_tokens =
5174                        self.charged_completion_tokens.saturating_sub(pending.delta);
5175                    Some((pv_events::StopReason::Other, reason))
5176                }
5177                Err(error) => {
5178                    self.session.mark_capture_failed();
5179                    self.pending_output.clear();
5180                    return Poll::Ready(Some(Err(std::io::Error::other(format!(
5181                        "completion budget task failed: {error}"
5182                    )))));
5183                }
5184            };
5185            if let Some((failure_reason, reason)) = failure {
5186                if let Err(error) = self.submit_response_capture(Some((failure_reason, reason.clone()))) {
5187                    self.session.mark_capture_failed();
5188                    self.pending_output.clear();
5189                    return Poll::Ready(Some(Err(std::io::Error::other(format!(
5190                        "response capture failed closed: {error}"
5191                    )))));
5192                }
5193                self.pending_output.clear();
5194                // QuotaExceeded is an in-process marker: the non-SSE
5195                // drain in `chat_completions` maps it to
5196                // `PipelineError::Blocked` → HTTP 403 (the same
5197                // deliberately-not-429 policy as the breaker path)
5198                // so budget refusals reach the client as a real
5199                // error instead of a severed body.
5200                return Poll::Ready(Some(Err(std::io::Error::new(
5201                    std::io::ErrorKind::QuotaExceeded,
5202                    format!("response blocked by token budget: {reason}"),
5203                ))));
5204            }
5205            match pending.continuation {
5206                BudgetContinuation::Emit(bytes) => {
5207                    self.emitted_any = true;
5208                    return Poll::Ready(Some(Ok(bytes)));
5209                }
5210                BudgetContinuation::ContinueNonSse => {}
5211                BudgetContinuation::FinishSse => {
5212                    if let Err(error) = self.submit_response_capture(None) {
5213                        self.session.mark_capture_failed();
5214                        return Poll::Ready(Some(Err(std::io::Error::other(format!(
5215                            "response capture failed closed: {error}"
5216                        )))));
5217                    }
5218                    self.completed = true;
5219                    return Poll::Ready(self.pending_output.pop_front().map(Ok));
5220                }
5221                BudgetContinuation::Hold => {
5222                    context.waker().wake_by_ref();
5223                    return Poll::Pending;
5224                }
5225                BudgetContinuation::FinishNonSse => {
5226                    if let Err(error) = self.submit_response_capture(None) {
5227                        self.session.mark_capture_failed();
5228                        self.pending_output.clear();
5229                        return Poll::Ready(Some(Err(std::io::Error::other(format!(
5230                            "response capture failed closed: {error}"
5231                        )))));
5232                    }
5233                    self.completed = true;
5234                    return Poll::Ready(self.pending_output.pop_front().map(Ok));
5235                }
5236            }
5237        }
5238
5239        if !self.is_sse {
5240            if self.completed {
5241                return Poll::Ready(self.pending_output.pop_front().map(Ok));
5242            }
5243            loop {
5244                match self.inner.as_mut().poll_next(context) {
5245                    Poll::Ready(Some(Ok(bytes))) => {
5246                        let delta = match self.absorb_network_chunk(&bytes) {
5247                            Ok(delta) => delta,
5248                            Err(error) => {
5249                                self.record_response_failure(&error);
5250                                self.pending_output.clear();
5251                                let error = self.abort_error(error);
5252                                return Poll::Ready(Some(Err(error)));
5253                            }
5254                        };
5255                        if let Some((policy, reason)) = self.egress_refusal(false) {
5256                            let error = self.refuse_egress(policy, reason);
5257                            return Poll::Ready(Some(Err(error)));
5258                        }
5259                        self.pending_output.push_back(bytes);
5260                        if delta > 0 {
5261                            self.begin_budget_check(delta, BudgetContinuation::ContinueNonSse);
5262                            context.waker().wake_by_ref();
5263                            return Poll::Pending;
5264                        }
5265                    }
5266                    Poll::Ready(Some(Err(error))) => {
5267                        let reason = error.to_string();
5268                        self.record_response_failure(&reason);
5269                        self.pending_output.clear();
5270                        let error = self.abort_error(reason);
5271                        return Poll::Ready(Some(Err(error)));
5272                    }
5273                    Poll::Pending => return Poll::Pending,
5274                    Poll::Ready(None) => {
5275                        let delta = match self.flush_protocol_buffer() {
5276                            Ok(delta) => delta,
5277                            Err(error) => {
5278                                self.record_response_failure(&error);
5279                                self.pending_output.clear();
5280                                let error = self.abort_error(error);
5281                                return Poll::Ready(Some(Err(error)));
5282                            }
5283                        };
5284                        if let Some((policy, reason)) = self.egress_refusal(true) {
5285                            let error = self.refuse_egress(policy, reason);
5286                            return Poll::Ready(Some(Err(error)));
5287                        }
5288                        self.apply_egress_transforms();
5289                        if delta > 0 {
5290                            self.begin_budget_check(delta, BudgetContinuation::FinishNonSse);
5291                            context.waker().wake_by_ref();
5292                            return Poll::Pending;
5293                        }
5294                        // A 200 with a completely EMPTY body produced no
5295                        // frame, so `absorb_frame`'s "successful provider
5296                        // response has no choices array" guard never ran —
5297                        // without this check the session would attest a
5298                        // clean assistant turn that never happened (while
5299                        // the strictly-less-broken `200 {}` body fails
5300                        // capture). `saw_chunk` exists precisely to gate
5301                        // this.
5302                        if self.upstream_status.is_success() && !self.saw_chunk {
5303                            // Attest the refused turn as a TERMINAL
5304                            // FAILURE before sealing: returning without a
5305                            // capture left Drop to submit one with
5306                            // failure=None (no flush error, no unbilled
5307                            // delta), journalling a Success-shaped Session
5308                            // event for exactly the body this guard
5309                            // refuses to attest.
5310                            let reason = "successful provider response has an empty body".to_owned();
5311                            self.record_response_failure(&reason);
5312                            self.session.mark_capture_failed();
5313                            self.pending_output.clear();
5314                            let error = self.abort_error(reason);
5315                            return Poll::Ready(Some(Err(error)));
5316                        }
5317                        if let Err(error) = self.submit_response_capture(None) {
5318                            self.session.mark_capture_failed();
5319                            self.pending_output.clear();
5320                            return Poll::Ready(Some(Err(std::io::Error::other(format!(
5321                                "response capture failed closed: {error}"
5322                            )))));
5323                        }
5324                        self.completed = true;
5325                        return Poll::Ready(self.pending_output.pop_front().map(Ok));
5326                    }
5327                }
5328            }
5329        }
5330
5331        if self.completed {
5332            // After an egress refusal mid-stream (error frame sent) or a
5333            // held stream relayed at the end, drain what is queued, then
5334            // end.
5335            return Poll::Ready(self.pending_output.pop_front().map(Ok));
5336        }
5337        match self.inner.as_mut().poll_next(context) {
5338            Poll::Ready(Some(Ok(bytes))) => match self.absorb_network_chunk(&bytes) {
5339                Ok(delta) => {
5340                    if let Some((policy, reason)) = self.egress_refusal(false) {
5341                        return self.refuse_sse_egress(policy, reason);
5342                    }
5343                    if self.hold_stream {
5344                        // Frames are kept in `held_frames`; nothing is
5345                        // relayed until the response is complete.
5346                        if delta > 0 {
5347                            self.begin_budget_check(delta, BudgetContinuation::Hold);
5348                        }
5349                        context.waker().wake_by_ref();
5350                        return Poll::Pending;
5351                    }
5352                    if delta == 0 {
5353                        self.emitted_any = true;
5354                        return Poll::Ready(Some(Ok(bytes)));
5355                    }
5356                    self.begin_budget_check(delta, BudgetContinuation::Emit(bytes));
5357                    context.waker().wake_by_ref();
5358                    Poll::Pending
5359                }
5360                Err(error) => {
5361                    self.record_response_failure(&error);
5362                    let error = self.abort_error(error);
5363                    Poll::Ready(Some(Err(error)))
5364                }
5365            },
5366            Poll::Ready(Some(Err(error))) => {
5367                let reason = error.to_string();
5368                self.record_response_failure(&reason);
5369                let error = self.abort_error(reason);
5370                Poll::Ready(Some(Err(error)))
5371            }
5372            Poll::Pending => Poll::Pending,
5373            Poll::Ready(None) => {
5374                let delta = match self.flush_protocol_buffer() {
5375                    Ok(delta) => delta,
5376                    Err(error) => {
5377                        self.record_response_failure(&error);
5378                        let error = self.abort_error(error);
5379                        return Poll::Ready(Some(Err(error)));
5380                    }
5381                };
5382                if let Some((policy, reason)) = self.egress_refusal(true) {
5383                    return self.refuse_sse_egress(policy, reason);
5384                }
5385                if self.hold_stream {
5386                    // Relay the held frames now, rewritten where a
5387                    // transform matched (verbatim otherwise).
5388                    self.apply_egress_transforms();
5389                    if self.pending_output.is_empty() {
5390                        let frames = std::mem::take(&mut self.held_frames);
5391                        for frame in frames {
5392                            self.pending_output.push_back(Bytes::from(frame));
5393                        }
5394                    }
5395                }
5396                if delta > 0 {
5397                    self.begin_budget_check(delta, BudgetContinuation::FinishSse);
5398                    context.waker().wake_by_ref();
5399                    return Poll::Pending;
5400                }
5401                // Same empty-body fail-closed guard as the non-SSE arm
5402                // above: a 200 SSE response that delivered zero bytes
5403                // must not be attested as a clean assistant turn.
5404                if self.upstream_status.is_success() && !self.saw_chunk {
5405                    // Same terminal-failure attestation as the non-SSE
5406                    // twin: seal AFTER capturing the refusal so Drop's
5407                    // failure=None capture cannot journal a
5408                    // Success-shaped event for the refused body.
5409                    let reason = "successful provider response has an empty body".to_owned();
5410                    self.record_response_failure(&reason);
5411                    self.session.mark_capture_failed();
5412                    let error = self.abort_error(reason);
5413                    return Poll::Ready(Some(Err(error)));
5414                }
5415                if let Err(error) = self.submit_response_capture(None) {
5416                    self.session.mark_capture_failed();
5417                    return Poll::Ready(Some(Err(std::io::Error::other(format!(
5418                        "response capture failed closed: {error}"
5419                    )))));
5420                }
5421                self.completed = true;
5422                Poll::Ready(self.pending_output.pop_front().map(Ok))
5423            }
5424        }
5425    }
5426}
5427
5428pub(crate) fn parse_provider_chunk(raw: &str) -> Result<Option<ParsedProviderChunk>, String> {
5429    // SSE spec (§9.2.4) requires the leading U+FEFF (BOM) to be
5430    // discarded once, at the start of the stream. Rust's `.trim()` does
5431    // not strip U+FEFF (char::is_whitespace() returns false for it), so
5432    // a provider that ships a BOM would otherwise cause every following
5433    // parse to fail on either `strip_prefix("data:")` (BOM before
5434    // "data") or `serde_json::from_str` (BOM before "{"). Do the strip
5435    // exactly once here; subsequent chunks in a stream will not carry
5436    // another BOM.
5437    let raw = raw.strip_prefix('\u{feff}').unwrap_or(raw);
5438    let mut message = String::new();
5439    let mut reasoning = String::new();
5440    let mut prompt_tokens = None;
5441    let mut completion_tokens = None;
5442    let mut cached_tokens = None;
5443    let mut usage_reported = false;
5444    let mut cost_usd_micros = 0u64;
5445    let mut cost_reported = false;
5446    let mut tool_call_deltas = Vec::new();
5447    let mut choice_deltas: Vec<ParsedChoiceDelta> = Vec::new();
5448    let mut is_sse = false;
5449    let mut data = Vec::new();
5450    // Track the last `event:` type seen in this frame. SSE §9.2.8 says
5451    // an SSE client dispatches by event name; "message" (empty or
5452    // omitted) is the default. ProofVisor attributes the `data:`
5453    // payload to the audit trail (receipt, ATIF) as if it were the
5454    // model's output — but a hostile upstream (rogue provider,
5455    // TLS-MITM at egress, misconfigured cache) can send
5456    // `event: error\ndata: {"choices":[{"delta":{"content":"…"}}]}` —
5457    // spec-compliant SSE clients (browsers, OpenAI SDK's error hook)
5458    // would dispatch that to the ERROR listener, so the user sees an
5459    // error UI while our receipt records the payload as the model's
5460    // response. That defeats the cryptographic-attestation posture.
5461    // Only accept `event:` empty or `"message"` for capture; other
5462    // types abort the frame with a diagnostic and let the caller
5463    // mark_capture_failed rather than sign attributable content.
5464    let mut event_type = String::new();
5465    for line in raw.split(['\r', '\n']) {
5466        if let Some(value) = line.strip_prefix("data:") {
5467            is_sse = true;
5468            // SSE spec (§9.2.6): strip exactly ONE leading U+0020
5469            // SPACE — the field is otherwise verbatim. `.trim_start()`
5470            // would eat runs of Unicode whitespace and silently
5471            // mis-account any provider that sends `data:  {...}` with a
5472            // meaningful second byte.
5473            data.push(value.strip_prefix(' ').unwrap_or(value));
5474        } else if let Some(value) = line.strip_prefix("event:") {
5475            is_sse = true;
5476            event_type = value.strip_prefix(' ').unwrap_or(value).to_owned();
5477        } else if line == "data"
5478            || line.starts_with("id:")
5479            || line.starts_with("retry:")
5480            || line.starts_with(':')
5481        {
5482            is_sse = true;
5483        }
5484    }
5485    if is_sse && !event_type.is_empty() && event_type != "message" {
5486        // Narrow the named-event refusal to
5487        // frames that actually carry captured data. A named-event
5488        // keepalive with an empty `data:` field (`event: ping\n\n`,
5489        // `event: heartbeat\n\n`) can't taint the audit surface — no
5490        // bytes are attributed to the receipt — so treat it as a
5491        // skipped frame rather than aborting the whole stream and
5492        // sealing the session. Only refuse when non-empty `data:`
5493        // lines would otherwise be attributed to the model output.
5494        //
5495        // A `data: [DONE]` line under a named event (e.g.
5496        // `event: summary\ndata: [DONE]\n\n` emitted by some OpenAI-
5497        // compat gateways as they finalise their own event stream)
5498        // is also attribution-free — the sentinel is not model
5499        // output — so it must NOT fail-close the whole stream just
5500        // because the terminator arrived under an unexpected event
5501        // name. Matches the Anthropic parser's ordering, which
5502        // short-circuits `[DONE]` before its named-event refusal.
5503        if data.iter().all(|entry| {
5504            let trimmed = entry.trim();
5505            trimmed.is_empty() || trimmed == "[DONE]"
5506        }) {
5507            return Ok(None);
5508        }
5509        return Err(format!(
5510            "provider SSE frame carries unsupported event type {event_type:?}; \
5511             ProofVisor only captures the default `message` event because non-message \
5512             events (error, ping, custom) are dispatched to different client listeners \
5513             per SSE §9.2.8 and would be attributed to the wrong audit surface"
5514        ));
5515    }
5516    let candidate = if is_sse {
5517        if data.is_empty() {
5518            return Ok(None);
5519        }
5520        data.join("\n")
5521    } else {
5522        raw.trim().to_owned()
5523    };
5524    // Robust `[DONE]` sentinel handling. Some providers double-terminate
5525    // (`data: [DONE]\ndata: [DONE]`), send trailing whitespace, or emit
5526    // an empty keepalive line followed by `[DONE]`. The strict
5527    // byte-exact check used to fail every subsequent stream on such
5528    // benign variants — `trim` + per-line probe catches them.
5529    if candidate.is_empty()
5530        || candidate.trim() == "[DONE]"
5531        || data
5532            .iter()
5533            .all(|entry| entry.trim().is_empty() || entry.trim() == "[DONE]")
5534            && !data.is_empty()
5535    {
5536        return Ok(None);
5537    }
5538    let value = serde_json::from_str::<Value>(&candidate)
5539        .map_err(|error| format!("invalid provider JSON frame: {error}"))?;
5540    // OpenAI-shape inline error: mid-stream on a 200 OK the provider
5541    // can ship `data: {"error":{"code":"…","message":"…","type":"…"}}`
5542    // (Azure OpenAI and every OpenAI-compat shim do the same). Pre-fix
5543    // this fell through to `has_choices = false` and aborted the
5544    // stream with the generic "successful provider response has no
5545    // choices array" — the actual `error.message` was discarded and
5546    // the receipt attested `stop_reason = Other` with no error text
5547    // for exactly the diagnostics an auditor needs (context overflow,
5548    // billing 402, safety terminal). Refuse the frame carrying the
5549    // provider's own reason instead. Anthropic's `event: error`
5550    // handler in provider.rs does the same for that dialect.
5551    if let Some(err_obj) = value.get("error").filter(|v| !v.is_null()) {
5552        let message = err_obj
5553            .get("message")
5554            .and_then(Value::as_str)
5555            .unwrap_or("provider ended stream with an unspecified error");
5556        let code = err_obj.get("code").and_then(Value::as_str).unwrap_or("");
5557        return Err(if code.is_empty() {
5558            format!("provider stream error: {message}")
5559        } else {
5560            format!("provider stream error [{code}]: {message}")
5561        });
5562    }
5563    let model_name = value.get("model").and_then(Value::as_str).map(str::to_owned);
5564    // OpenAI streams with `stream_options: {"include_usage": true}` carry
5565    // `"usage": null` on every content chunk, with the real usage object
5566    // only on the final chunk (vLLM/LiteLLM shims do the same). A null
5567    // usage must fall through to the estimate/accumulate path exactly like
5568    // an absent key: flagging it as reported would feed absorb_frame's
5569    // cumulative-usage branch a per-chunk heuristic estimate, which both
5570    // kills the stream with a spurious "provider completion usage
5571    // regressed" error (estimates are not monotonic) and, when estimates
5572    // happen to stay monotonic, zeroes every mid-stream budget delta.
5573    if let Some(usage) = value.get("usage").filter(|usage| !usage.is_null()) {
5574        usage_reported = true;
5575        prompt_tokens = provider_u64(usage.get("prompt_tokens"), "prompt_tokens")?.or(prompt_tokens);
5576        completion_tokens =
5577            provider_u64(usage.get("completion_tokens"), "completion_tokens")?.or(completion_tokens);
5578        cached_tokens = provider_u64(
5579            usage.pointer("/prompt_tokens_details/cached_tokens"),
5580            "cached_tokens",
5581        )?
5582        .or(cached_tokens);
5583    }
5584    let cost_value = value.pointer("/usage/cost_usd").or_else(|| value.get("cost_usd"));
5585    if let Some(cost_value) = cost_value {
5586        let cost = cost_value
5587            .as_f64()
5588            .ok_or_else(|| "provider cost_usd is not a number".to_owned())?;
5589        if !cost.is_finite() || cost < 0.0 {
5590            return Err("provider cost_usd is not finite and nonnegative".to_owned());
5591        }
5592        #[allow(clippy::cast_possible_truncation, clippy::cast_sign_loss)]
5593        {
5594            let micros = (cost * pv_core::units::USD_MICROS_PER_DOLLAR as f64).round();
5595            if micros > pv_core::error::JCS_SAFE_MAX as f64 {
5596                return Err("provider cost exceeds JCS-safe receipt bounds".to_owned());
5597            }
5598            cost_usd_micros = micros as u64;
5599            cost_reported = true;
5600        }
5601    }
5602    let has_choices = value.get("choices").is_some();
5603    let choices = match value.get("choices") {
5604        Some(Value::Array(choices)) => Some(choices),
5605        Some(_) => return Err("provider choices is not an array".to_owned()),
5606        None => None,
5607    };
5608    if let Some(choices) = choices {
5609        for (choice_position, choice) in choices.iter().enumerate() {
5610            // Distinguish choices in multi-choice (`n > 1`) responses:
5611            // tool-call deltas are keyed by (choice, tool index) downstream,
5612            // otherwise `choices[0].tool_calls[0]` and
5613            // `choices[1].tool_calls[0]` merge into one corrupt audit record
5614            // (concatenated argument fragments, last-writer-wins id/name).
5615            let choice_index = choice
5616                .get("index")
5617                .and_then(Value::as_u64)
5618                .or_else(|| u64::try_from(choice_position).ok())
5619                .unwrap_or(u64::MAX);
5620            let mut choice_delta = ParsedChoiceDelta {
5621                index: choice_index,
5622                ..ParsedChoiceDelta::default()
5623            };
5624            if let Some(reason) = choice
5625                .get("finish_reason")
5626                .and_then(Value::as_str)
5627                .filter(|s| !s.is_empty())
5628            {
5629                // empty-string finish_reason from
5630                // OpenAI-compatible shims used to enter the audit
5631                // chain as `Some("")`, which the JSON schema then
5632                // rejects at publish (`minLength: 1`) — permanently
5633                // fail-closing the session AFTER the bytes were
5634                // already relayed. Treat empty as absent.
5635                choice_delta.finish_reason = Some(reason.to_owned());
5636            }
5637            let content = choice
5638                .pointer("/delta/content")
5639                .or_else(|| choice.pointer("/message/content"))
5640                .and_then(content_text);
5641            if let Some(content) = content.as_deref() {
5642                message.push_str(content);
5643                choice_delta.content.push_str(content);
5644            }
5645            // A refusal is model output the client shows, like content.
5646            let refusal = choice
5647                .pointer("/delta/refusal")
5648                .or_else(|| choice.pointer("/message/refusal"))
5649                .and_then(Value::as_str);
5650            if let Some(refusal) = refusal {
5651                message.push_str(refusal);
5652                choice_delta.content.push_str(refusal);
5653            }
5654            let reasoning_content = choice
5655                .pointer("/delta/reasoning_content")
5656                .or_else(|| choice.pointer("/message/reasoning_content"))
5657                .and_then(Value::as_str);
5658            if let Some(content) = reasoning_content {
5659                reasoning.push_str(content);
5660                choice_delta.reasoning.push_str(content);
5661            }
5662            choice_deltas.push(choice_delta);
5663            let streaming_calls = choice.pointer("/delta/tool_calls");
5664            let calls = streaming_calls
5665                .or_else(|| choice.pointer("/message/tool_calls"))
5666                .map(|calls| {
5667                    calls
5668                        .as_array()
5669                        .ok_or_else(|| "provider tool_calls is not an array".to_owned())
5670                })
5671                .transpose()?;
5672            if let Some(calls) = calls {
5673                for (position, call) in calls.iter().enumerate() {
5674                    let index = match call.get("index").and_then(Value::as_u64) {
5675                        Some(index) => index,
5676                        None if streaming_calls.is_some() => {
5677                            return Err("streaming provider tool call has no index".to_owned());
5678                        }
5679                        None => u64::try_from(position)
5680                            .map_err(|_| "provider tool-call index overflow".to_owned())?,
5681                    };
5682                    tool_call_deltas.push(ProviderToolCallDelta {
5683                        choice_index,
5684                        index,
5685                        complete: false,
5686                        id: call.get("id").and_then(Value::as_str).map(str::to_owned),
5687                        name: call
5688                            .pointer("/function/name")
5689                            .and_then(Value::as_str)
5690                            .map(str::to_owned),
5691                        arguments: call
5692                            .pointer("/function/arguments")
5693                            .and_then(Value::as_str)
5694                            .unwrap_or_default()
5695                            .to_owned(),
5696                    });
5697                }
5698            }
5699        }
5700    }
5701    let completion_reported = completion_tokens.is_some();
5702    let completion_tokens = completion_tokens.unwrap_or_else(|| {
5703        let mut estimated = pv_core::tokens::approx_tokens(&message)
5704            .saturating_add(pv_core::tokens::approx_tokens(&reasoning));
5705        for call in &tool_call_deltas {
5706            estimated = estimated
5707                .saturating_add(call.name.as_deref().map_or(0, pv_core::tokens::approx_tokens))
5708                .saturating_add(pv_core::tokens::approx_tokens(&call.arguments));
5709        }
5710        estimated
5711    });
5712    Ok(Some(ParsedProviderChunk {
5713        model_name,
5714        metrics: pv_events::EventMetrics {
5715            prompt_tokens,
5716            completion_tokens: Some(completion_tokens),
5717            cached_tokens,
5718            pruned_tokens: None,
5719            pruning_ratio_millis: None,
5720        },
5721        usage_reported,
5722        completion_reported,
5723        cost_usd_micros,
5724        cost_reported,
5725        has_choices,
5726        tool_call_deltas,
5727        choices: choice_deltas,
5728    }))
5729}
5730
5731pub(crate) fn provider_u64(value: Option<&Value>, field: &str) -> Result<Option<u64>, String> {
5732    let Some(value) = value else {
5733        return Ok(None);
5734    };
5735    // Some OpenAI-compatible shims emit explicit nulls for usage fields
5736    // they don't track; treat them like absent keys rather than failing
5737    // the frame.
5738    if value.is_null() {
5739        return Ok(None);
5740    }
5741    let value = value
5742        .as_u64()
5743        .ok_or_else(|| format!("provider {field} is not a nonnegative integer"))?;
5744    if value > pv_core::error::JCS_SAFE_MAX {
5745        return Err(format!("provider {field} exceeds JCS-safe bounds"));
5746    }
5747    Ok(Some(value))
5748}
5749
5750/// Fold the accumulated provider tool-call arguments string into
5751/// the JSON `Value` the signed ATIF step attests.
5752///
5753/// Zero-arg parity across the three provider adapters:
5754/// - OpenAI's `"arguments":"{}"` accumulates as `"{}"` on the wire.
5755/// - Gemini's `functionCall` without `args` is emitted as `"{}"` by
5756///   the adapter (its deltas are `complete: true`, so no
5757///   concatenation risk).
5758/// - Anthropic streaming ships `content_block_start` with
5759///   `"input":{}` as a PLACEHOLDER, then follows with
5760///   `input_json_delta.partial_json` chunks that this accumulator
5761///   CONCATENATES; emitting `"{}"` from the placeholder would
5762///   corrupt every non-empty streaming tool_use to `{}{"city":…}`
5763///   at the accumulator. The Anthropic adapter therefore emits `""`
5764///   from the placeholder and this helper NORMALISES an empty
5765///   accumulator to `"{}"` before parsing — so a truly-zero-arg
5766///   streaming tool_use still attests as `{}` (matching OpenAI /
5767///   Gemini) instead of the pre-R14 `{"raw":""}` fallback.
5768///
5769/// Any other unparseable raw (concatenation left corrupt bytes on
5770/// the wire, or provider sent invalid JSON) still falls through to
5771/// the `{"raw": …}` capture — the auditor sees the exact bytes.
5772pub(crate) fn normalize_tool_call_arguments(raw: &str) -> serde_json::Value {
5773    let candidate = if raw.is_empty() { "{}" } else { raw };
5774    serde_json::from_str(candidate).unwrap_or_else(|_| json!({"raw": raw}))
5775}
5776
5777pub(crate) fn map_finish_reason(native: &str) -> pv_events::StopReason {
5778    match native {
5779        "stop" | "stop_sequence" | "end_turn" => pv_events::StopReason::Stop,
5780        // Anthropic's `model_context_window_exceeded` is the same
5781        // semantic as OpenAI's `length` / Gemini's `MAX_TOKENS` (the
5782        // model hit a length limit). Pre-fix it fell through to Other
5783        // — a capacity dashboard grouping sessions by "Length" missed
5784        // Anthropic overflows.
5785        "length" | "max_tokens" | "model_context_window_exceeded" => pv_events::StopReason::MaxTokens,
5786        "tool_calls" | "function_call" | "tool_use" => pv_events::StopReason::ToolUse,
5787        // Anthropic's `pause_turn` (Claude 3.7+ extended-thinking +
5788        // tool sessions) is a natural mid-response continuation
5789        // awaiting a resume — semantically a tool-shaped stop, not a
5790        // "we're done" stop. Fold with tool_use so dashboards
5791        // grouping tool sessions catch these too, matching the
5792        // existing pattern of provider-native aliasing above.
5793        "pause_turn" => pv_events::StopReason::ToolUse,
5794        // Anthropic's `refusal` (Claude Sonnet 4.5+) is a safety refusal
5795        // — the same semantic as OpenAI's `content_filter` and the
5796        // cluster Gemini folds via map_gemini_finish_reason. Pre-fix it
5797        // fell through to Other, silently splitting safety-refusal
5798        // analytics along provider lines (verified live: an Anthropic
5799        // response with stop_reason=refusal journalled stop_reason_id=99
5800        // where OpenAI/Gemini equivalents journalled id=90).
5801        "content_filter" | "refusal" => pv_events::StopReason::ContentFilter,
5802        _ => pv_events::StopReason::Other,
5803    }
5804}
5805
5806impl Drop for AbortFinalizingStream {
5807    fn drop(&mut self) {
5808        // Session-being-closed intentionally still captures: `wait_for_streams`
5809        // in `close_session_locked` is blocked on this stream's `SessionLease`,
5810        // so the response_capture we submit here will land before finalize
5811        // reads the chain / atif.
5812        if self.completed {
5813            // A completed EPHEMERAL one-shot (no client X-PV-Session —
5814            // the generated id only travels back in the response
5815            // header) must close NOW: OPENAI-COMPATIBILITY.md promises
5816            // "the session then closes immediately after the response —
5817            // one turn, one audit event", and before this arm the
5818            // session sat OPEN until the idle sweeper
5819            // (`session_idle_close_s`, default 900 s) — a stock SDK
5820            // caller's signed receipt was 15 minutes late. Reproduced
5821            // live pre-fix: open_count=1, zero receipts, 3 s after a
5822            // 200. The client cannot address the generated id again, so
5823            // there is no future turn to keep the session open for.
5824            if self.ephemeral && !self.session.is_closed() && self.session.active_streams_count() <= 1 {
5825                let session = Arc::clone(&self.session);
5826                let finalizer = self.finalizer.clone();
5827                let session_id = session.id.clone();
5828                if let Ok(runtime) = tokio::runtime::Handle::try_current() {
5829                    runtime.spawn(async move {
5830                        // Catch panics inside `close_session` (bridge
5831                        // publish, receipt-signing JCS overflow, a
5832                        // metric-registry collision on any lazy
5833                        // `.counter(...)`, tracing Display allocator
5834                        // failure): a panicking async body in a
5835                        // detached `spawn` is silently swallowed by
5836                        // tokio's default `UnhandledPanic::Ignore`,
5837                        // so the operator would never see the class.
5838                        // Emit the panic counter so
5839                        // `rate(pv_ephemeral_close_panics_total)`
5840                        // catches it. Same discipline as the workspace's
5841                        // long-lived loops (reconciler, worker, bridge).
5842                        let outcome = std::panic::AssertUnwindSafe(
5843                            finalizer.close_session(session, StopReason::SessionClosed),
5844                        )
5845                        .catch_unwind()
5846                        .await;
5847                        match outcome {
5848                            Ok(Ok(_)) => {}
5849                            Ok(Err(error)) => {
5850                                finalizer
5851                                    .metrics()
5852                                    .counter(
5853                                        "pv_ephemeral_close_failures_total",
5854                                        "Auto-close of a completed ephemeral one-shot failed; \
5855                                         the session is left open until the idle sweeper reaps it",
5856                                    )
5857                                    .inc();
5858                                tracing::warn!(
5859                                    %error,
5860                                    session = %session_id,
5861                                    "auto-close of completed ephemeral session failed"
5862                                );
5863                            }
5864                            Err(panic) => {
5865                                let msg = panic
5866                                    .downcast_ref::<&'static str>()
5867                                    .copied()
5868                                    .or_else(|| panic.downcast_ref::<String>().map(String::as_str))
5869                                    .unwrap_or("panic payload was not a string");
5870                                finalizer
5871                                    .metrics()
5872                                    .counter(
5873                                        "pv_ephemeral_close_panics_total",
5874                                        "Auto-close of a completed ephemeral one-shot panicked \
5875                                         and was caught; the session is left open until the idle \
5876                                         sweeper reaps it",
5877                                    )
5878                                    .inc();
5879                                tracing::warn!(
5880                                    session = %session_id,
5881                                    panic = %msg,
5882                                    "auto-close of completed ephemeral session PANICKED (caught)"
5883                                );
5884                            }
5885                        }
5886                    });
5887                }
5888                // No runtime (shutdown-time drop): the idle sweeper /
5889                // recovery own the close, exactly as before this arm.
5890            }
5891            return;
5892        }
5893        // Capture is_closed once so the fail-closed guards below agree on
5894        // the same view. When a concurrent close is already draining this
5895        // stream via `wait_for_streams`, the finalize path is imminent and
5896        // we must not `mark_capture_failed` on the last budget check /
5897        // trailing frame — otherwise `close_session_locked`'s post-drain
5898        // `capture_failed` guard seals the session (`mark_artifact_committed`
5899        // + committed claim) and returns `CaptureIncomplete`: the close is
5900        // never retried and the session finalizes with no artifact at all.
5901        //
5902        // A client disconnect mid-budget-check
5903        // or a garbled trailing frame is a per-RESPONSE failure — the
5904        // audit chain is still consistent because we can record the
5905        // truncation reason via `submit_response_capture(Some(_))`.
5906        // Sealing the whole session (which the previous fail-closed logic
5907        // did) bricked every future turn of the agent conversation for
5908        // any transient network hiccup. `mark_capture_failed()` is now
5909        // reserved for the one genuinely fatal drop path: the audit
5910        // worker itself is unreachable, so no future response could be
5911        // safely captured either.
5912        let is_closed = self.session.is_closed();
5913        let budget_incomplete = self.pending_budget.is_some();
5914        // Abort the pending budget task. `spawn_blocking`
5915        // returns a JoinHandle whose Drop does NOT cancel the queued
5916        // closure; the blocking pool would otherwise run
5917        // `ActionBudget::try_tokens(delta)` AFTER the drop, silently
5918        // debiting the session's budget key for a request the client
5919        // never received. `abort()` is best-effort for a closure
5920        // already picked up by the blocking pool (blocking tasks
5921        // have no cancellation points) but reliably cancels a
5922        // still-queued task — closing the common case. A full fix
5923        // would thread a shutdown token into `try_tokens`; deferred
5924        // until that helper takes a cancellation argument.
5925        if let Some(pending) = self.pending_budget.take() {
5926            pending.task.abort();
5927            // The aborted check's delta was folded into
5928            // `charged_completion_tokens` by `absorb_frame` but its debit
5929            // never landed (abort reliably cancels a queued blocking
5930            // task). Roll it back so the terminal over-charge refund
5931            // below cannot credit tokens that were never debited. If the
5932            // abort raced a task already RUNNING on the blocking pool
5933            // (no cancellation points), the debit may still land — the
5934            // rollback then under-refunds by one delta, i.e. the ledger
5935            // keeps a conservative over-debit, matching the documented
5936            // principal-side posture. Never the reverse.
5937            self.charged_completion_tokens = self.charged_completion_tokens.saturating_sub(pending.delta);
5938        }
5939        let (flush_reason, budget_delta) = match self.flush_protocol_buffer() {
5940            Ok(delta) => (None, delta),
5941            Err(error) => {
5942                tracing::warn!(%error, "provider stream flush failed on drop");
5943                (Some(format!("provider stream flush failed: {error}")), 0u64)
5944            }
5945        };
5946        // The flushed tail's frames bumped `charged_completion_tokens`,
5947        // but on the drop path no `begin_budget_check` follows — the
5948        // delta is discarded, never debited. Same rollback as the
5949        // drain-loop error arms, or the terminal refund credits the
5950        // unbilled tail against debits that never happened.
5951        self.charged_completion_tokens = self.charged_completion_tokens.saturating_sub(budget_delta);
5952        // Compose a per-response failure reason. `budget_incomplete`
5953        // dominates because it always implies the client disconnected
5954        // before the last chunk was billed; a garbled frame is next
5955        // most specific; an unbilled tail (delta > 0 with no
5956        // per-chunk error) means the connection dropped between the
5957        // last successful budget check and the flush.
5958        let response_failure: Option<String> = if budget_incomplete {
5959            Some("client disconnected before response budget check completed".to_owned())
5960        } else if let Some(reason) = flush_reason {
5961            Some(reason)
5962        } else if budget_delta > 0 {
5963            Some(format!(
5964                "client disconnected with {budget_delta} unbilled response bytes"
5965            ))
5966        } else {
5967            None
5968        };
5969        if let Err(error) = self.submit_response_capture(
5970            // Client-disconnect shapes — attested Other, not enforcement.
5971            response_failure.map(|reason| (pv_events::StopReason::Other, reason)),
5972        ) {
5973            tracing::warn!(%error, "response-capture submit failed on drop");
5974            if !is_closed {
5975                // The audit worker is unreachable — no future response
5976                // on this session could be captured either. This is
5977                // the one genuinely session-fatal drop path.
5978                self.session.mark_capture_failed();
5979            }
5980        }
5981        // A client disconnect must
5982        // not seal the whole conversation. Spawn the background close
5983        // ONLY when this abort left nothing capturable AND no
5984        // concurrent stream is in flight AND the session is an
5985        // ephemeral one-shot (no client X-PV-Session) — the case
5986        // where the session would otherwise linger as an empty
5987        // husk until the idle sweeper: the client never learned the
5988        // generated id, so no future turn can address it. In every
5989        // other case the session stays OPEN: the truncated turn was
5990        // recorded above via response capture, a client retrying with
5991        // the same session id keeps working, and the idle sweeper
5992        // finalizes if the client never comes back. This was the
5993        // direct trigger for the §6.1 recycled-id artifact
5994        // destruction. Without the `ephemeral` gate (mirroring the
5995        // completed-arm at the top of this fn), a multi-turn session
5996        // whose latest turn aborted before any upstream byte arrived
5997        // was force-closed with StopReason::Other; the client's next
5998        // turn silently opened a NEW session under the same string id
5999        // (get_or_open sees close_complete), fragmenting the audit
6000        // chain that OPENAI-COMPATIBILITY.md promises stays continuous
6001        // until POST /close or the idle sweeper.
6002        // NB: our own SessionLease is still held during this body
6003        // (fields drop after Drop::drop), so `> 1` means "another
6004        // stream besides ours".
6005        let nothing_captured = !self.saw_chunk && self.captured_bytes == 0;
6006        let other_streams = self.session.active_streams_count() > 1;
6007        if self.ephemeral && !is_closed && nothing_captured && !other_streams {
6008            let session = Arc::clone(&self.session);
6009            let finalizer = self.finalizer.clone();
6010            let session_id = session.id.clone();
6011            let stop_reason = StopReason::Other;
6012            match tokio::runtime::Handle::try_current() {
6013                Ok(runtime) => {
6014                    // Detach: the drop is sync and cannot await. Mirror
6015                    // the outcome to tracing *and* a Prometheus counter
6016                    // so a PromQL alert can catch the class — the
6017                    // fallback path is otherwise invisible until the
6018                    // idle sweeper reaps the "still open" session.
6019                    // `catch_unwind`: an async body panicking inside
6020                    // detached `tokio::spawn` is silently swallowed by
6021                    // tokio's default `UnhandledPanic::Ignore`. Route
6022                    // the panic to `pv_stream_abort_panics_total` so
6023                    // the class shows up on `/metrics` — matches the
6024                    // discipline every other background-loop
6025                    // supervisor in this workspace applies.
6026                    runtime.spawn(async move {
6027                        let outcome =
6028                            std::panic::AssertUnwindSafe(finalizer.close_session(session, stop_reason))
6029                                .catch_unwind()
6030                                .await;
6031                        match outcome {
6032                            Ok(Ok(_)) => {}
6033                            Ok(Err(error)) => {
6034                                finalizer
6035                                    .metrics()
6036                                    .counter(
6037                                        "pv_stream_abort_close_failures_total",
6038                                        "Background close after a stream abort failed; \
6039                                         the session is left open until the idle sweeper reaps it",
6040                                    )
6041                                    .inc();
6042                                tracing::warn!(
6043                                    %error,
6044                                    session = %session_id,
6045                                    "background close on stream abort failed"
6046                                );
6047                            }
6048                            Err(panic) => {
6049                                let msg = panic
6050                                    .downcast_ref::<&'static str>()
6051                                    .copied()
6052                                    .or_else(|| panic.downcast_ref::<String>().map(String::as_str))
6053                                    .unwrap_or("panic payload was not a string");
6054                                finalizer
6055                                    .metrics()
6056                                    .counter(
6057                                        "pv_stream_abort_panics_total",
6058                                        "Background close after a stream abort panicked and was \
6059                                         caught; the session is left open until the idle sweeper \
6060                                         reaps it",
6061                                    )
6062                                    .inc();
6063                                tracing::warn!(
6064                                    session = %session_id,
6065                                    panic = %msg,
6066                                    "background close on stream abort PANICKED (caught)"
6067                                );
6068                            }
6069                        }
6070                    });
6071                }
6072                Err(error) => {
6073                    // Runtime is gone (shutdown, drop from a blocking
6074                    // thread) — there is no place to await the close.
6075                    // Mark capture failed so the reconciler retries on
6076                    // the next tick instead of finalising a session
6077                    // that never ran to completion.
6078                    self.finalizer
6079                        .metrics()
6080                        .counter(
6081                            "pv_stream_abort_no_runtime_total",
6082                            "Stream abort observed no tokio runtime; capture marked failed for \
6083                             reconciler retry",
6084                        )
6085                        .inc();
6086                    tracing::warn!(
6087                        %error,
6088                        session = %session_id,
6089                        "no tokio runtime available for stream-abort close; marking capture failed for reconciler retry"
6090                    );
6091                    self.session.mark_capture_failed();
6092                }
6093            }
6094        }
6095    }
6096}
6097
6098/// The text of a message's `content`: a string, or, when it is an array
6099/// of content parts, the `text` or `refusal` of each part whatever its
6100/// type (a part the client shows must not escape the judge).
6101fn content_text(content: &Value) -> Option<std::borrow::Cow<'_, str>> {
6102    match content {
6103        Value::String(text) => Some(std::borrow::Cow::Borrowed(text)),
6104        Value::Array(parts) => Some(std::borrow::Cow::Owned(
6105            parts
6106                .iter()
6107                .filter_map(|part| {
6108                    part.get("text")
6109                        .and_then(Value::as_str)
6110                        .or_else(|| part.get("refusal").and_then(Value::as_str))
6111                })
6112                .collect(),
6113        )),
6114        _ => None,
6115    }
6116}

6140    /// Register item 25 sub-clause: OPENAI-COMPATIBILITY.md is the
6141    /// integration-facing route contract. Pass 31 audit found the
6142    /// bare `/mcp` route (registered alongside `/v1/mcp` for MCP SDK
6143    /// convention) was documented in CONFIGURATION.md's
6144    /// `max_request_bytes` but MISSING from OPENAI-COMPATIBILITY.md's
6145    /// route split. An integration engineer following the doc would
6146    /// assume MCP SDKs must POST to `/v1/mcp`; a client posting to
6147    /// the standard `/mcp` path would succeed, but the doc's
6148    /// silence about it is silently confusing.
6149    ///
6150    /// Every real client-facing agent-API route this crate registers
6151    /// must appear verbatim in OPENAI-COMPATIBILITY.md. Adding a new
6152    /// route to `build_router` without updating the doc now trips CI.
6153    #[test]
6154    fn openai_compatibility_documents_every_client_facing_route() {
6155        let doc = include_str!("../../../docs/reference/OPENAI-COMPATIBILITY.md");
6156        // The client-facing agent API surface — routes an SDK or MCP
6157        // client will POST to. Operational probes (/health, /livez,
6158        // /readyz, /metrics) and the operator/dashboard surface
6159        // (/api/v1/...) are documented separately (OPERATIONS.md /
6160        // the dashboard section) and are explicitly out of scope of
6161        // this test to avoid pinning them to the wrong doc.
6162        //
6163        // Each route is checked with distinguishing context — a bare
6164        // substring check would treat `/v1/mcp` as satisfying the
6165        // `/mcp` requirement (found live pass 31 while red-testing
6166        // this exact scenario). The context strings are what the doc
6167        // uniquely uses for each variant.
6168        for (route, must_contain) in [
6169            ("/v1/chat/completions", "`/v1/chat/completions`"),
6170            ("/v1/mcp", "`/v1/mcp`"),
6171            // Distinguish the bare route by its "bare `/mcp`" phrase
6172            // — the same character sequence used inside `/v1/mcp`
6173            // would otherwise let the substring check pass.
6174            ("/mcp (bare, MCP SDK convention)", "bare `/mcp`"),
6175            ("/v1/sessions/{id}/close", "`/v1/sessions/{id}/close`"),
6176            ("/v1/sessions/{id}/promote", "`/v1/sessions/{id}/promote`"),
6177        ] {
6178            assert!(
6179                doc.contains(must_contain),
6180                "route {route} is registered by build_router but the doc is missing \
6181                 its distinguishing marker {must_contain:?} — an integration \
6182                 engineer following the doc will not know it exists. Add a row to \
6183                 the route table (or the /v1 vs /api/v1 split section) and re-run."
6184            );
6185        }
6186    }

6218                .clone()

6229            assert_eq!(
6230                response.status(),

6233                 section promises it does; update the doc with the new behavior"
6234            );
6235        }
6236    }
