6238    /// Register item 25 (docs drift) — sub-clause for the product
6239    /// console at docs/app/. It ships as an offline HTML/JS
6240    /// simulation of the whole operator flow (setup, sessions,
6241    /// receipt verification, evidence layout) and is the customer-
6242    /// facing evaluation surface. Every named factual claim in the
6243    /// console must be pinned to real code: schema, topics, status
6244    /// codes, and the stop-reason taxonomy. If the code drifts and
6245    /// nobody updates the console, prospects clicking through it
6246    /// see a product that no longer exists.
6247    ///
6248    /// Verified accurate live pass 32; this test locks the pins so
6249    /// any future rename in receipt.rs, model.rs, or the topic set
6250    /// trips CI unless the console is updated too.
6251    #[test]
6252    fn product_console_pins_match_real_schema_and_taxonomy() {
6253        // The pitch/investor walkthrough moved to /app/pitch/ when the
6254        // main console became a multi-tenant SaaS app. That's the surface
6255        // that still renders sample receipts word-for-word, so this test
6256        // continues to pin against it.
6257        let console_js = include_str!("../../../docs/app/pitch/console.js");
6258        let console_html = include_str!("../../../docs/app/pitch/index.html");
6259        let combined = format!("{console_js}\n{console_html}");
6260
6261        // Receipt version — the console shows receipt_version: 2 as
6262        // the SIGNED-body claim. If pv-receipts bumps to v3 the
6263        // console's tour renders a version that never existed.
6264        assert_eq!(
6265            pv_receipts::RECEIPT_VERSION,
6266            2,
6267            "receipt version bumped from 2; update docs/app/pitch/console.js's \
6268             receiptHtml() to render the new version",
6269        );
6270        assert!(
6271            combined.contains(r#""receipt_version""#) && combined.contains(">2<"),
6272            "the console must render receipt_version = 2 to match \
6273             pv_receipts::RECEIPT_VERSION",
6274        );
6275
6276        // Every ReceiptBody top-level key the console renders must
6277        // be a real field. A rename in receipt.rs without touching
6278        // the console makes the sample receipt structurally invalid.
6279        for key in [
6280            "receipt_version",
6281            "receipt_id",
6282            "session_id",
6283            "issued_at",
6284            "issued_at_iso",
6285            "ai_agent",
6286            "subject",
6287            "tool_calls",
6288            "cost",
6289            "stop_reason_id",
6290            "stop_reason",
6291            "key_id",
6292            "public_key_b64",
6293            "signature_b64",
6294        ] {
6295            assert!(
6296                combined.contains(&format!(r#""{key}""#)),
6297                "receipt field `{key}` is not rendered by the product \
6298                 console — either the field was renamed (update the \
6299                 console) or the console was truncated (update this test)",
6300            );
6301        }
6302
6303        // The receipt's cost sub-block: rename any of these and the
6304        // console's tampering demo (change one digit of cost_usd_micros
6305        // → signature refuses to verify) suddenly points at a field
6306        // that does not exist.
6307        for cost_key in [
6308            "prompt_tokens",
6309            "completion_tokens",
6310            "cached_tokens",
6311            "cost_usd_micros",
6312        ] {
6313            assert!(
6314                combined.contains(&format!(r#""{cost_key}""#)),
6315                "cost field `{cost_key}` is not rendered by the console",
6316            );
6317        }
6318
6319        // The tampering demo targets cost_usd_micros. Pin the
6320        // console's tamper-target field name so if we ever move the
6321        // integer field the demo doesn't silently point at a String.
6322        assert!(
6323            combined.contains("cost_usd_micros"),
6324            "console tampering demo relies on cost_usd_micros being \
6325             the integer field it changes; rename would break the demo",
6326        );
6327
6328        // Stop reason id 92 = "Budget Exceeded" — the console renders
6329        // exactly this pair for the receipt sample (the tour text
6330        // says "the receipt attests a session that hit its budget").
6331        assert_eq!(
6332            pv_events::StopReason::BudgetExceeded.id(),
6333            92,
6334            "BudgetExceeded id changed from 92; update the console's \
6335             sample receipt receiptHtml()",
6336        );
6337        assert_eq!(
6338            pv_events::StopReason::BudgetExceeded.caption(),
6339            "Budget Exceeded",
6340            "BudgetExceeded caption changed; update the console",
6341        );
6342        assert!(
6343            combined.contains(r#""stop_reason_id""#) && combined.contains(">92<"),
6344            "console must render stop_reason_id = 92 to match \
6345             StopReason::BudgetExceeded",
6346        );
6347        assert!(
6348            combined.contains("Budget Exceeded"),
6349            "console must render the 'Budget Exceeded' caption for the \
6350             sample receipt",
6351        );
6352
6353        // OCSF topics named by the console's evidence tree. The
6354        // bridge topic list has drifted in the past; any rename
6355        // that removes agent.tool_call or agent.session breaks the
6356        // console's "OCSF events → your SIEM" claim silently.
6357        for topic in ["agent.tool_call", "agent.session"] {
6358            assert!(
6359                combined.contains(topic),
6360                "OCSF topic `{topic}` is not rendered by the console but is \
6361                 shown as the file that lands in the operator's SIEM",
6362            );
6363        }
6364
6365        // The 403 policy-refusal HTTP status is the console's core
6366        // "money kept in the building" demo (issue_refund $8,400
6367        // refused → HTTP 403). Pinned against the pipeline's
6368        // Blocked → 403 mapping (openai_error_body_test elsewhere).
6369        assert!(
6370            combined.contains("HTTP 403"),
6371            "console must render the 403 policy-refusal status the \
6372             pipeline emits (deliberately not 429, which SDKs auto-retry)",
6373        );
6374
6375        // The default listen port shown throughout the setup + one-line
6376        // integration sections.
6377        assert!(
6378            combined.contains("127.0.0.1:8484"),
6379            "console must render the default listen address 127.0.0.1:8484; \
6380             raise or lower the default and the setup/curl blocks lie",
6381        );
6382
6383        // The wizard-preview TOML must render `max_tool_calls` in its
6384        // real SHAPE, not just its name: `BudgetSpec.max_tool_calls` is
6385        // a per-tool map (`[budget.max_tool_calls]` table), and the
6386        // console once rendered it as a bare scalar under `[budget]` —
6387        // a config that `deny_unknown_fields` + serde reject with
6388        // "invalid type: integer, expected a map" the moment a prospect
6389        // copies the "written for you, live" file. Substring name
6390        // checks alone codified that drift; pin the shape.
6391        assert!(
6392            combined.contains("budget.max_tool_calls"),
6393            "console's TOML preview must render the per-tool cap as the \
6394             `[budget.max_tool_calls]` table the real BudgetSpec requires",
6395        );
6396        assert!(
6397            !console_js.contains(r#"max_tool_calls</span> = "#),
6398            "console's TOML preview renders `max_tool_calls = <scalar>`, \
6399             which the real config parser rejects (BudgetSpec.max_tool_calls \
6400             is a BTreeMap; the valid shape is a [budget.max_tool_calls] table)",
6401        );
6402    }

6404    struct NullBus;
6405
6406    struct SlowStore {
6407        inner: InMemoryStore,
6408        calls: Arc<std::sync::atomic::AtomicUsize>,
6409    }
6410
6411    impl StateStore for SlowStore {
6412        fn add(&self, key: &str, delta: u64) -> Result<u64, StateError> {
6413            self.inner.add(key, delta)
6414        }
6415
6416        fn get(&self, key: &str) -> Result<u64, StateError> {
6417            self.inner.get(key)
6418        }
6419
6420        fn try_spend(&self, key: &str, amount: u64, limit: u64) -> Result<bool, StateError> {
6421            self.calls.fetch_add(1, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::AcqRel);
6422            std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(100));
6423            self.inner.try_spend(key, amount, limit)
6424        }
6425
6426        fn try_spend_many(&self, spends: &[Spend]) -> Result<pv_state::TrySpendOutcome, StateError> {
6427            // R68: `ActionBudget::try_tokens` now routes through
6428            // `try_spend_many` (single-key) so the reported
6429            // `remaining` comes from the atomic section that
6430            // committed the spend (R66 F3). Instrument this path
6431            // identically to `try_spend` so `SlowStore` still
6432            // observes the reactor-blocking regression test
6433            // (`completion_budget_store_does_not_block_stream_runtime`
6434            // asserts the two per-request spend calls).
6435            self.calls.fetch_add(1, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::AcqRel);
6436            std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(100));
6437            self.inner.try_spend_many(spends)
6438        }
6439
6440        fn remove(&self, key: &str) {
6441            self.inner.remove(key);
6442        }
6443    }

6445    impl EventBus for NullBus {
6446        fn publish(&self, topic: &str, _key: &str, _value: &Value) -> Result<PublishAck, BusError> {
6447            Ok(PublishAck {
6448                topic: topic.to_owned(),
6449                partition: 0,
6450                offset: 0,
6451            })
6452        }
6453
6454        fn fetch(
6455            &self,
6456            _topic: &str,
6457            _partition: u32,
6458            _offset: u64,
6459            _max: usize,
6460        ) -> Result<Vec<StoredEvent>, BusError> {
6461            Ok(Vec::new())
6462        }
6463
6464        fn partitions(&self, _topic: &str) -> Result<u32, BusError> {
6465            Ok(1)
6466        }
6467
6468        fn topics(&self) -> Vec<String> {
6469            pv_events::EventClass::all()
6470                .iter()
6471                .map(|class| class.topic().to_owned())
6472                .collect()
6473        }
6474    }

6476    async fn mock_chat(Json(payload): Json<Value>) -> Response {
6477        if payload.get("model").and_then(Value::as_str) == Some("empty-error") {
6478            let mut response = Response::new(Body::empty());
6479            *response.status_mut() = StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR;
6480            response.headers_mut().insert(
6481                axum::http::header::CONTENT_TYPE,
6482                HeaderValue::from_static("application/json"),
6483            );
6484            return response;
6485        }
6486        if payload.get("model").and_then(Value::as_str) == Some("json-error") {
6487            return (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, Json(json!({}))).into_response();
6488        }
6489        if payload.get("model").and_then(Value::as_str) == Some("empty-success") {
6490            return Json(json!({})).into_response();
6491        }
6492        if payload.get("model").and_then(Value::as_str) == Some("split-sse") {
6493            // One SSE frame split across two TCP chunks, cut mid-way
6494            // through the é's UTF-8 encoding (0xc3 0xa9). Exercises the
6495            // protocol_buffer reassembly path that no other SSE mock
6496            // reaches (every other SSE mock emits whole
6497            // frames per chunk).
6498            let frame = "data: {\"choices\":[{\"delta\":{\"content\":\"héllo\"},\"finish_reason\":\"stop\"}]}\n\ndata: [DONE]\n\n"
6499                .as_bytes()
6500                .to_vec();
6501            let split = frame.iter().position(|byte| *byte == 0xc3).unwrap() + 1;
6502            let chunks = vec![
6503                Ok::<_, std::convert::Infallible>(Bytes::copy_from_slice(&frame[..split])),
6504                Ok(Bytes::copy_from_slice(&frame[split..])),
6505            ];
6506            let mut response = Response::new(Body::from_stream(futures::stream::iter(chunks)));
6507            response.headers_mut().insert(
6508                axum::http::header::CONTENT_TYPE,
6509                HeaderValue::from_static("text/event-stream"),
6510            );
6511            return response;
6512        }
6513        if payload.get("model").and_then(Value::as_str) == Some("truncated-stream") {
6514            // One delta, then a clean end: no finish_reason, no usage,
6515            // no [DONE] — the §6.4 truncation shape (provider crash,
6516            // LB idle-timeout).
6517            let mut response = Response::new(Body::from(
6518                "data: {\"choices\":[{\"delta\":{\"content\":\"partial ans\"}}]}\n\n",
6519            ));
6520            response.headers_mut().insert(
6521                axum::http::header::CONTENT_TYPE,
6522                HeaderValue::from_static("text/event-stream"),
6523            );
6524            return response;
6525        }
6526        if payload.get("model").and_then(Value::as_str) == Some("severed-stream") {
6527            // One delta, a real pause (so the pipeline's peek-before-
6528            // commit completes and the response is streaming through
6529            // `AbortFinalizingStream`), then a mid-flight stream ERROR —
6530            // the wire shape of a provider crash / LB kill (TCP RST),
6531            // distinct from `truncated-stream`'s clean body end. Without
6532            // the pause the error surfaces during the pipeline's initial
6533            // send instead, which is a different (already-Other) path.
6534            let chunks = futures::stream::unfold(0u8, |state| async move {
6535                match state {
6536                    0 => Some((
6537                        Ok::<_, std::io::Error>(Bytes::from_static(
6538                            b"data: {\"choices\":[{\"delta\":{\"content\":\"partial ans\"}}]}\n\n",
6539                        )),
6540                        1,
6541                    )),
6542                    1 => {
6543                        tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(150)).await;
6544                        Some((Err(std::io::Error::other("connection reset by peer")), 2))
6545                    }
6546                    _ => None,
6547                }
6548            });
6549            let mut response = Response::new(Body::from_stream(chunks));
6550            response.headers_mut().insert(
6551                axum::http::header::CONTENT_TYPE,
6552                HeaderValue::from_static("text/event-stream"),
6553            );
6554            return response;
6555        }
6556        if payload.get("model").and_then(Value::as_str) == Some("provisional-usage") {
6557            let chunks = vec![
6558                Ok::<_, std::convert::Infallible>(Bytes::from_static(
6559                    b"data: {\"choices\":[{\"delta\":{\"content\":\"hello\"}}]}\n\n",
6560                )),
6561                Ok(Bytes::from_static(
6562                    b"data: {\"choices\":[],\"usage\":{\"prompt_tokens\":10,\"completion_tokens\":2}}\n\n",
6563                )),
6564            ];
6565            let mut response = Response::new(Body::from_stream(futures::stream::iter(chunks)));
6566            response.headers_mut().insert(
6567                axum::http::header::CONTENT_TYPE,
6568                HeaderValue::from_static("text/event-stream"),
6569            );
6570            return response;
6571        }
6572        if payload.get("model").and_then(Value::as_str) == Some("tool-no-usage") {
6573            let arguments = "x".repeat(4_096);
6574            let event = format!(
6575                "data: {{\"choices\":[{{\"delta\":{{\"tool_calls\":[{{\"index\":0,\"function\":{{\"name\":\"read\",\"arguments\":\"{arguments}\"}}}}]}}}}]}}\n\n"
6576            );
6577            let mut response = Response::new(Body::from(event));
6578            response.headers_mut().insert(
6579                axum::http::header::CONTENT_TYPE,
6580                HeaderValue::from_static("text/event-stream"),
6581            );
6582            return response;
6583        }
6584        if payload.get("model").and_then(Value::as_str) == Some("tool-oob-index") {
6585            let event = "data: {\"choices\":[{\"delta\":{\"tool_calls\":[{\"index\":18446744073709551615,\"function\":{\"name\":\"read\",\"arguments\":\"{}\"}}]}}]}\n\n";
6586            let mut response = Response::new(Body::from(event));
6587            response.headers_mut().insert(
6588                axum::http::header::CONTENT_TYPE,
6589                HeaderValue::from_static("text/event-stream"),
6590            );
6591            return response;
6592        }
6593        if payload.get("model").and_then(Value::as_str) == Some("tool-conflicting-id") {
6594            // One frame, two deltas landing on the same accumulator slot
6595            // (choice 0, index 0) with DIFFERENT ids — the malformed
6596            // shape the id-conflict guard must fail closed on.
6597            let event = "data: {\"choices\":[{\"delta\":{\"tool_calls\":[{\"index\":0,\"id\":\"call-a\",\"function\":{\"name\":\"read\",\"arguments\":\"{\"}},{\"index\":0,\"id\":\"call-b\",\"function\":{\"arguments\":\"}\"}}]}}]}\n\n";
6598            let mut response = Response::new(Body::from(event));
6599            response.headers_mut().insert(
6600                axum::http::header::CONTENT_TYPE,
6601                HeaderValue::from_static("text/event-stream"),
6602            );
6603            return response;
6604        }
6605        if payload.get("model").and_then(Value::as_str) == Some("tool-conflicting-name") {
6606            // Same slot, same id, DIFFERENT function names — the
6607            // name-conflict arm of the reuse guard.
6608            let event = "data: {\"choices\":[{\"delta\":{\"tool_calls\":[{\"index\":0,\"id\":\"call-a\",\"function\":{\"name\":\"read\",\"arguments\":\"{\"}},{\"index\":0,\"id\":\"call-a\",\"function\":{\"name\":\"db_write\",\"arguments\":\"}\"}}]}}]}\n\n";
6609            let mut response = Response::new(Body::from(event));
6610            response.headers_mut().insert(
6611                axum::http::header::CONTENT_TYPE,
6612                HeaderValue::from_static("text/event-stream"),
6613            );
6614            return response;
6615        }
6616        if payload.get("model").and_then(Value::as_str) == Some("overcharged-completion") {
6617            // Content chunk with `"usage": null` (estimate-charged), then an
6618            // authoritative usage frame LOWER than the estimate — the
6619            // completion-side over-charge shape.
6620            let chunks = vec![
6621                Ok::<_, std::convert::Infallible>(Bytes::from_static(
6622                    b"data: {\"choices\":[{\"delta\":{\"content\":\"aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa\"},\"finish_reason\":\"stop\"}]}\n\n",
6623                )),
6624                Ok(Bytes::from_static(
6625                    b"data: {\"choices\":[],\"usage\":{\"prompt_tokens\":1,\"completion_tokens\":1}}\n\n",
6626                )),
6627            ];
6628            let mut response = Response::new(Body::from_stream(futures::stream::iter(chunks)));
6629            response.headers_mut().insert(
6630                axum::http::header::CONTENT_TYPE,
6631                HeaderValue::from_static("text/event-stream"),
6632            );
6633            return response;
6634        }
6635        if payload.get("model").and_then(Value::as_str) == Some("regressive-usage") {
6636            let chunks = vec![
6637                Ok::<_, std::convert::Infallible>(Bytes::from_static(
6638                    b"data: {\"choices\":[{\"delta\":{\"content\":\"first\"}}],\"usage\":{\"prompt_tokens\":10,\"completion_tokens\":100,\"prompt_tokens_details\":{\"cached_tokens\":5}},\"cost_usd\":0.01}\n\n",
6639                )),
6640                Ok(Bytes::from_static(
6641                    b"data: {\"choices\":[{\"delta\":{\"content\":\"second\"}}],\"usage\":{\"prompt_tokens\":9,\"completion_tokens\":1,\"prompt_tokens_details\":{\"cached_tokens\":4}},\"cost_usd\":0.001}\n\n",
6642                )),
6643            ];
6644            let mut response = Response::new(Body::from_stream(futures::stream::iter(chunks)));
6645            response.headers_mut().insert(
6646                axum::http::header::CONTENT_TYPE,
6647                HeaderValue::from_static("text/event-stream"),
6648            );
6649            return response;
6650        }
6651        if payload.get("model").and_then(Value::as_str) == Some("split-json") {
6652            let body = serde_json::to_vec(&json!({
6653                "model": "split-json",
6654                "choices": [{"message": {"role": "assistant", "content": "héllo"}}],
6655                "usage": {"prompt_tokens": 5, "completion_tokens": 2}
6656            }))
6657            .unwrap();
6658            let split = body.iter().position(|byte| *byte == 0xc3).unwrap() + 1;
6659            let chunks = vec![
6660                Ok::<_, std::convert::Infallible>(Bytes::copy_from_slice(&body[..split])),
6661                Ok(Bytes::copy_from_slice(&body[split..])),
6662            ];
6663            let mut response = Response::new(Body::from_stream(futures::stream::iter(chunks)));
6664            response.headers_mut().insert(
6665                axum::http::header::CONTENT_TYPE,
6666                HeaderValue::from_static("application/json"),
6667            );
6668            return response;
6669        }
6670        if payload.get("model").and_then(Value::as_str) == Some("gzip-encoded") {
6671            // Body content is irrelevant: the encoding refusal fires on
6672            // the header alone, before any byte is read.
6673            let mut response = Response::new(Body::from("compressed-bytes"));
6674            response.headers_mut().insert(
6675                axum::http::header::CONTENT_TYPE,
6676                HeaderValue::from_static("application/json"),
6677            );
6678            response.headers_mut().insert(
6679                axum::http::header::CONTENT_ENCODING,
6680                HeaderValue::from_static("gzip"),
6681            );
6682            return response;
6683        }
6684        if payload.get("model").and_then(Value::as_str) == Some("malformed-json") {
6685            let mut response = Response::new(Body::from("{\"choices\":["));
6686            response.headers_mut().insert(
6687                axum::http::header::CONTENT_TYPE,
6688                HeaderValue::from_static("application/json"),
6689            );
6690            return response;
6691        }
6692        if payload.get("stream").and_then(Value::as_bool).unwrap_or(false) {
6693            let event = "data: {\"choices\":[{\"delta\":{\"content\":\"hello\"},\"finish_reason\":\"stop\"}],\"usage\":{\"prompt_tokens\":10,\"completion_tokens\":3,\"cost_usd\":0.00125,\"prompt_tokens_details\":{\"cached_tokens\":4}}}\n\ndata: [DONE]\n\n";
6694            let bytes = event.as_bytes();
6695            let chunks = vec![
6696                Ok::<_, std::convert::Infallible>(Bytes::copy_from_slice(&bytes[..19])),
6697                Ok(Bytes::copy_from_slice(&bytes[19..97])),
6698                Ok(Bytes::copy_from_slice(&bytes[97..])),
6699            ];
6700            let mut response = Response::new(Body::from_stream(futures::stream::iter(chunks)));
6701            response.headers_mut().insert(
6702                axum::http::header::CONTENT_TYPE,
6703                HeaderValue::from_static("text/event-stream"),
6704            );
6705            response
6706        } else {
6707            Json(json!({"choices": [{"message": {"role": "assistant", "content": "hello"}}]})).into_response()
6708        }
6709    }

6711    async fn counting_tool(
6712        State(calls): State<Arc<std::sync::atomic::AtomicUsize>>,
6713        body: Bytes,
6714    ) -> Response {
6715        calls.fetch_add(1, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::AcqRel);
6716        (StatusCode::OK, body).into_response()
6717    }
6718
6719    async fn redirecting_tool(State(calls): State<Arc<std::sync::atomic::AtomicUsize>>) -> Response {
6720        calls.fetch_add(1, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::AcqRel);
6721        (
6722            StatusCode::TEMPORARY_REDIRECT,
6723            [(axum::http::header::LOCATION, "/effect")],
6724        )
6725            .into_response()
6726    }
6727
6728    async fn redirected_effect(State(calls): State<Arc<std::sync::atomic::AtomicUsize>>) -> Response {
6729        calls.fetch_add(1, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::AcqRel);
6730        StatusCode::OK.into_response()
6731    }

6733    struct HeldToolState {
6734        arrived: std::sync::atomic::AtomicBool,
6735        release: tokio::sync::Notify,
6736    }
6737
6738    async fn held_tool(State(state): State<Arc<HeldToolState>>, body: Bytes) -> Response {
6739        state.arrived.store(true, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Release);
6740        state.release.notified().await;
6741        (StatusCode::OK, body).into_response()
6742    }

6800    /// The body-limit rejection must honour the JSON
6801    /// error contract and name the knob + limit — axum's default is a
6802    /// bare text/plain "length limit exceeded".
6803    #[tokio::test]
6804    async fn oversize_body_413_is_json_and_names_the_knob() {
6805        let directory = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
6806        let (state, provider) = test_state(directory.path()).await;
6807        let limit = state.config.max_request_bytes;
6808        let app = build_router(state);
6809        let oversize = "x".repeat(limit + 1);
6810        let response = app
6811            .oneshot(
6812                Request::builder()
6813                    .method("POST")
6814                    .uri("/v1/chat/completions")
6815                    .header("content-type", "application/json")
6816                    .header("x-pv-session", "too-big")
6817                    .body(Body::from(oversize))
6818                    .unwrap(),
6819            )
6820            .await
6821            .unwrap();
6822        assert_eq!(response.status(), StatusCode::PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE);
6823        let content_type = response
6824            .headers()
6825            .get(axum::http::header::CONTENT_TYPE)
6826            .and_then(|value| value.to_str().ok())
6827            .unwrap_or_default()
6828            .to_owned();
6829        assert!(
6830            content_type.starts_with("application/json"),
6831            "413 must honour the JSON error contract, got {content_type}"
6832        );
6833        let body: Value = serde_json::from_slice(
6834            &axum::body::to_bytes(response.into_body(), 64 * 1024)
6835                .await
6836                .unwrap(),
6837        )
6838        .unwrap();
6839        let message = body["error"]["message"].as_str().unwrap();
6840        assert!(
6841            message.contains("max_request_bytes") && message.contains(&limit.to_string()),
6842            "413 must name the knob and the configured limit: {message}"
6843        );
6844        provider.abort();
6845    }

6890    /// S3 step 3: a session against a mock Gemini
6891    /// upstream produces the same audit-chain shape as an OpenAI one —
6892    /// provider-true usage, SCREAMING_CASE stop reason folded into the
6893    /// stop taxonomy, and the native stream translated to OpenAI chunks.
6894    #[tokio::test]
6895    async fn gemini_session_records_the_same_audit_shape() {
6896        let directory = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
6897        let (state, provider) = test_state_gemini(directory.path()).await;
6898        let app = build_router(state.clone());
6899        let response = app.clone().oneshot(chat_request("gemini-flow")).await.unwrap();
6900        assert_eq!(response.status(), StatusCode::OK);
6901        let body = axum::body::to_bytes(response.into_body(), 64 * 1024)
6902            .await
6903            .unwrap();
6904        let body = String::from_utf8_lossy(&body);
6905        assert!(
6906            body.contains("hello from gemini"),
6907            "the translated stream must carry the upstream text: {body}"
6908        );
6909        assert!(
6910            body.contains("\"object\":\"chat.completion.chunk\"")
6911                && !body.contains("candidates")
6912                && body.trim_end().ends_with("data: [DONE]"),
6913            "an OpenAI client must receive OpenAI chunks, not the native stream: {body}"
6914        );
6915
6916        let session = state.sessions.get("gemini-flow").unwrap();
6917        session.wait_for_worker_jobs().await;
6918        use std::sync::atomic::Ordering;
6919        assert_eq!(session.totals.prompt_tokens.load(Ordering::Acquire), 25);
6920        assert_eq!(session.totals.completion_tokens.load(Ordering::Acquire), 15);
6921
6922        let close = app
6923            .clone()
6924            .oneshot(
6925                Request::builder()
6926                    .method("POST")
6927                    .uri("/v1/sessions/gemini-flow/close")
6928                    .body(Body::empty())
6929                    .unwrap(),
6930            )
6931            .await
6932            .unwrap();
6933        assert_eq!(close.status(), StatusCode::OK);
6934        let promoted = app
6935            .clone()
6936            .oneshot(
6937                Request::builder()
6938                    .method("POST")
6939                    .uri("/v1/sessions/gemini-flow/promote")
6940                    .body(Body::empty())
6941                    .unwrap(),
6942            )
6943            .await
6944            .unwrap();
6945        assert_eq!(promoted.status(), StatusCode::OK);
6946        let receipt: pv_receipts::Receipt = serde_json::from_slice(
6947            &axum::body::to_bytes(promoted.into_body(), 64 * 1024)
6948                .await
6949                .unwrap(),
6950        )
6951        .unwrap();
6952        receipt.verify_embedded().unwrap();
6953        assert_eq!(receipt.body.stop_reason_id, pv_events::StopReason::Stop.id());
6954        assert_eq!(receipt.body.cost.prompt_tokens, 25);
6955        assert_eq!(receipt.body.cost.completion_tokens, 15);
6956        provider.abort();
6957    }

6967            "data: {\"candidates\":[{\"content\":{\"parts\":[]},\"finishReason\":\"STOP\",\"index\":0}],\"usageMetadata\":{\"promptTokenCount\":15,\"candidatesTokenCount\":10}}\n\n",
6968        );

7005    /// Register item 28: the ProviderAdapter trait exists so downstream
7006    /// code sees ONE canonical shape regardless of the upstream. That
7007    /// includes stop-reason semantics — a session where the agent
7008    /// invoked a tool must attest `StopReason::ToolUse` regardless of
7009    /// which provider was upstream. OpenAI emits `finish_reason:
7010    /// "tool_calls"` and Anthropic emits `stop_reason: "tool_use"` in
7011    /// this case, both mapping cleanly to ToolUse. Gemini does NOT: it
7012    /// emits `finishReason: STOP` and expects the client to notice the
7013    /// `functionCall` part. Without normalization the receipt attests
7014    /// `StopReason::Stop` for the Gemini flow — an auditor grouping
7015    /// sessions by `stop_reason` would count Gemini tool sessions as
7016    /// clean stops and OpenAI/Anthropic tool sessions as tool_use.
7017    /// That is exactly the adapter-leak the trait exists to prevent.
7018    #[tokio::test]
7019    async fn gemini_tool_call_with_finish_stop_attests_tool_use() {
7020        let directory = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
7021        let (state, provider) = test_state_gemini_tool(directory.path()).await;
7022        let app = build_router(state.clone());
7023        let response = app.clone().oneshot(chat_request("gemini-tool")).await.unwrap();
7024        assert_eq!(response.status(), StatusCode::OK);
7025        let _ = axum::body::to_bytes(response.into_body(), 64 * 1024).await;
7026        let session = state.sessions.get("gemini-tool").unwrap();
7027        session.wait_for_worker_jobs().await;
7028
7029        // The receipt is the ground truth: a Gemini tool-call session
7030        // must record ToolUse (id 3), not Stop (id 1).
7031        let close = app
7032            .clone()
7033            .oneshot(
7034                Request::builder()
7035                    .method("POST")
7036                    .uri("/v1/sessions/gemini-tool/close")
7037                    .body(Body::empty())
7038                    .unwrap(),
7039            )
7040            .await
7041            .unwrap();
7042        assert_eq!(close.status(), StatusCode::OK);
7043        let promoted = app
7044            .clone()
7045            .oneshot(
7046                Request::builder()
7047                    .method("POST")
7048                    .uri("/v1/sessions/gemini-tool/promote")
7049                    .body(Body::empty())
7050                    .unwrap(),
7051            )
7052            .await
7053            .unwrap();
7054        assert_eq!(promoted.status(), StatusCode::OK);
7055        let receipt: pv_receipts::Receipt = serde_json::from_slice(
7056            &axum::body::to_bytes(promoted.into_body(), 64 * 1024)
7057                .await
7058                .unwrap(),
7059        )
7060        .unwrap();
7061        receipt.verify_embedded().unwrap();
7062        assert_eq!(
7063            receipt.body.stop_reason_id,
7064            pv_events::StopReason::ToolUse.id(),
7065            "a Gemini session that ended with a functionCall part must attest \
7066             StopReason::ToolUse (id {}), not Stop (id {}) — the adapter must \
7067             normalize provider-specific quirks so downstream stop-reason \
7068             analytics are provider-agnostic. Received: stop_reason_id={}, \
7069             stop_reason={:?}.",
7070            pv_events::StopReason::ToolUse.id(),
7071            pv_events::StopReason::Stop.id(),
7072            receipt.body.stop_reason_id,
7073            receipt.body.stop_reason,
7074        );
7075        provider.abort();
7076    }

7078    /// Gemini parallel function calling: two COMPLETE `functionCall`
7079    /// parts arriving in SEPARATE streamed chunks. Gemini part
7080    /// positions restart at 0 in every chunk, so keying the
7081    /// accumulator on the frame-local position collided both calls at
7082    /// (choice 0, index 0): same-name calls concatenated their args
7083    /// into one unparseable record (attested as `{"raw": ...}`), and
7084    /// different-name calls hard-failed a legitimate stream on the
7085    /// name-conflict guard. Complete deltas must each get a fresh slot.
7086    async fn mock_gemini_parallel_tool_chat() -> Response {
7087        let frames = concat!(
7088            "data: {\"candidates\":[{\"content\":{\"parts\":[{\"functionCall\":{\"name\":\"get_weather\",\"args\":{\"city\":\"Paris\"}}}]},\"index\":0}],\"usageMetadata\":{\"promptTokenCount\":15,\"candidatesTokenCount\":10},\"modelVersion\":\"gemini-2.0-flash\"}\n\n",
7089            "data: {\"candidates\":[{\"content\":{\"parts\":[{\"functionCall\":{\"name\":\"get_time\",\"args\":{\"city\":\"London\"}}}]},\"index\":0}],\"usageMetadata\":{\"promptTokenCount\":15,\"candidatesTokenCount\":20}}\n\n",
7090            "data: {\"candidates\":[{\"content\":{\"parts\":[]},\"finishReason\":\"STOP\",\"index\":0}],\"usageMetadata\":{\"promptTokenCount\":15,\"candidatesTokenCount\":20}}\n\n",
7091        );
7092        let mut response = Response::new(Body::from(frames));
7093        response.headers_mut().insert(
7094            axum::http::header::CONTENT_TYPE,
7095            HeaderValue::from_static("text/event-stream"),
7096        );
7097        response
7098    }
7099
7100    #[tokio::test]
7101    async fn gemini_parallel_function_calls_across_chunks_attest_as_two_calls() {
7102        let directory = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
7103        let listener = tokio::net::TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").await.unwrap();
7104        let address = listener.local_addr().unwrap();
7105        let upstream = Router::new().route(
7106            "/v1beta/models/mock:streamGenerateContent",

7108        );
7109        let provider = tokio::spawn(async move {
7110            axum::serve(listener, upstream).await.unwrap();
7111        });
7112        let mut config = crate::config::HarnessConfig::for_tests(
7113            &format!("http://{address}"),
7114            &directory.path().to_string_lossy(),
7115            &directory.path().to_string_lossy(),
7116        );
7117        config.provider = "gemini".to_owned();
7118        let state = AppState::new(
7119            config,
7120            Arc::new(InMemoryStore::new()),
7121            Arc::new(Sandbox::new(SandboxConfig::default(), Vec::new()).unwrap()),
7122            Arc::new(NullBus),
7123            None,
7124            Arc::new(Ed25519Signer::from_seed(&[17; 32])),
7125        )
7126        .unwrap();
7127        let app = build_router(state.clone());
7128        let response = app
7129            .clone()
7130            .oneshot(chat_request("gemini-parallel-tools"))
7131            .await
7132            .unwrap();
7133        assert_eq!(response.status(), StatusCode::OK, "the stream must not hard-fail");
7134        let _ = axum::body::to_bytes(response.into_body(), 64 * 1024).await;
7135        let session = state.sessions.get("gemini-parallel-tools").unwrap();
7136        session.wait_for_worker_jobs().await;
7137        let close = app
7138            .clone()
7139            .oneshot(
7140                Request::builder()
7141                    .method("POST")
7142                    .uri("/v1/sessions/gemini-parallel-tools/close")
7143                    .body(Body::empty())
7144                    .unwrap(),
7145            )
7146            .await
7147            .unwrap();
7148        assert_eq!(close.status(), StatusCode::OK);
7149
7150        // The unsigned ATIF trajectory is the attested ground truth.
7151        let digest = pv_core::digest::sha256_hex(b"gemini-parallel-tools");
7152        let stem = digest.get(..32).unwrap();
7153        let trajectory: serde_json::Value =
7154            serde_json::from_slice(&std::fs::read(directory.path().join(format!("{stem}.json"))).unwrap())
7155                .unwrap();
7156        let mut calls: Vec<(String, serde_json::Value)> = Vec::new();
7157        for step in trajectory
7158            .pointer("/steps")
7159            .and_then(serde_json::Value::as_array)
7160            .cloned()
7161            .unwrap_or_default()
7162        {
7163            for call in step
7164                .pointer("/tool_calls")
7165                .and_then(serde_json::Value::as_array)
7166                .cloned()
7167                .unwrap_or_default()
7168            {
7169                calls.push((
7170                    call.pointer("/function_name")
7171                        .and_then(serde_json::Value::as_str)
7172                        .unwrap_or_default()
7173                        .to_owned(),
7174                    call.pointer("/arguments").cloned().unwrap_or_default(),
7175                ));
7176            }
7177        }
7178        assert_eq!(
7179            calls.len(),
7180            2,
7181            "two functionCall parts in separate chunks must attest as two \
7182             distinct tool calls, not merge at frame-local index 0: {trajectory}"
7183        );
7184        assert_eq!(calls[0].0, "get_weather");
7185        assert_eq!(calls[0].1, serde_json::json!({"city": "Paris"}));
7186        assert_eq!(calls[1].0, "get_time");
7187        assert_eq!(calls[1].1, serde_json::json!({"city": "London"}));
7188        provider.abort();
7189    }

7491                    .method("POST")
7492                    .uri("/v1/sessions/anthropic-flow/promote")
7493                    .body(Body::empty())
7494                    .unwrap(),
7495            )
7496            .await
7497            .unwrap();
7498        assert_eq!(promoted.status(), StatusCode::OK);
7499        let receipt: pv_receipts::Receipt = serde_json::from_slice(
7500            &axum::body::to_bytes(promoted.into_body(), 64 * 1024)
7501                .await
7502                .unwrap(),

7504        .unwrap();
7505        receipt.verify_embedded().unwrap();
7506        // `end_turn` folds into the same Stop id an OpenAI `stop` does.
7507        assert_eq!(receipt.body.stop_reason_id, pv_events::StopReason::Stop.id());
7508        assert_eq!(receipt.body.cost.prompt_tokens, 25);
7509        assert_eq!(receipt.body.cost.completion_tokens, 15);
7510        provider.abort();
7511    }

7545    /// OPENAI-COMPATIBILITY.md session semantics: a request WITHOUT
7546    /// `X-PV-Session` gets a server-generated id and "the session then
7547    /// closes immediately after the response — one turn, one audit
7548    /// event". Reproduced live pre-fix: 3 s after a 200, the session
7549    /// was still OPEN with zero receipts — a stock SDK caller's signed
7550    /// receipt waited on the idle sweeper (default 900 s).
7551    #[tokio::test]
7552    async fn header_less_one_shot_closes_immediately_after_the_response() {
7553        let directory = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
7554        let (state, provider) = test_state(directory.path()).await;
7555        let request = Request::builder()
7556            .method("POST")
7557            .uri("/v1/chat/completions")
7558            .header(axum::http::header::CONTENT_TYPE, "application/json")
7559            // NO x-pv-session: the id is server-generated (ephemeral).
7560            .header("x-pv-workflow", "unsigned")
7561            .body(Body::from(serde_json::to_vec(&chat_payload()).unwrap()))
7562            .unwrap();
7563        let response = build_router(state.clone()).oneshot(request).await.unwrap();
7564        assert_eq!(response.status(), StatusCode::OK);
7565        let session_id = response
7566            .headers()
7567            .get("x-pv-session")
7568            .and_then(|v| v.to_str().ok())
7569            .expect("generated session id must be echoed in the response header")
7570            .to_owned();
7571        axum::body::to_bytes(response.into_body(), 1024 * 1024)
7572            .await
7573            .unwrap();
7574
7575        let session = state.sessions.get(&session_id).expect("session registered");
7576        let deadline = std::time::Instant::now() + std::time::Duration::from_secs(10);
7577        while !session.is_closed() {
7578            assert!(
7579                std::time::Instant::now() < deadline,
7580                "an ephemeral one-shot must close immediately after the response,                  not wait for the idle sweeper"
7581            );
7582            tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(50)).await;
7583        }
7584        provider.abort();
7585    }
7586
7587    /// Register item 8 (bind budget to principal), completion side.
7588    /// Admission debits both ledgers, but mid-stream/terminal
7589    /// completion tokens used to debit ONLY the session ledger — under
7590    /// the session-header-rotation attack the principal ledger is the
7591    /// only one that binds, so streamed completions were invisible to
7592    /// it: measured live, a rotating caller consumed >10× the
7593    /// principal token cap (refusal came from the ~30-token admission
7594    /// heuristic alone). Two rotated requests whose completions
7595    /// (1000 reported tokens each) dwarf their admission estimates:
7596    /// the second must be refused by `principal.max_tokens`, which
7597    /// only happens if completion tokens land on the principal ledger.
7598    #[tokio::test]
7599    async fn principal_budget_charges_completion_tokens_across_rotated_sessions() {
7600        let directory = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
7601        let listener = tokio::net::TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").await.unwrap();
7602        let address = listener.local_addr().unwrap();
7603        let provider = Router::new().route(
7604            "/v1/chat/completions",
7605            post(|| async {
7606                Json(json!({
7607                    "model": "mock",
7608                    "choices": [{
7609                        "message": {"role": "assistant", "content": "big completion"},
7610                        "finish_reason": "stop"
7611                    }],
7612                    "usage": {"prompt_tokens": 5, "completion_tokens": 1000}
7613                }))
7614            }),
7615        );
7616        let server = tokio::spawn(async move {
7617            axum::serve(listener, provider).await.unwrap();
7618        });
7619        let spool = directory.path().to_string_lossy().into_owned();
7620        let mut config =
7621            crate::config::HarnessConfig::for_tests(&format!("http://{address}"), &spool, &spool);
7622        // Session ledger wide open: only the principal ledger can refuse.
7623        config.budget.max_tokens = Some(1_000_000);
7624        // Fits one admission (~30) + one completion (1000) + a second
7625        // admission, but NOT the second completion.
7626        config.principal_budget = Some(pv_state::BudgetSpec {
7627            max_tokens: Some(1500),
7628            ..pv_state::BudgetSpec::default()
7629        });
7630        let state = AppState::new(
7631            config,
7632            Arc::new(InMemoryStore::new()),
7633            Arc::new(Sandbox::new(SandboxConfig::default(), Vec::new()).unwrap()),
7634            Arc::new(NullBus),
7635            None,
7636            Arc::new(Ed25519Signer::from_seed(&[11; 32])),
7637        )
7638        .unwrap();
7639        let app = build_router(state);
7640        let non_streamed = json!({
7641            "model": "mock",
7642            "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "hello"}]
7643        });
7644
7645        let first = app
7646            .clone()
7647            .oneshot(chat_request_with_payload("principal-rot-1", non_streamed.clone()))
7648            .await
7649            .unwrap();
7650        assert_eq!(
7651            first.status(),
7652            StatusCode::OK,
7653            "first rotated request fits the principal budget"
7654        );
7655        axum::body::to_bytes(first.into_body(), 1024 * 1024)
7656            .await
7657            .unwrap();
7658
7659        // Different session id, same (anonymous) principal: its virgin
7660        // session ledger cannot refuse — only the principal ledger,
7661        // and only if the FIRST request's 1000 completion tokens
7662        // actually landed there.
7663        let second = app
7664            .oneshot(chat_request_with_payload("principal-rot-2", non_streamed))
7665            .await
7666            .unwrap();
7667        let status = second.status();
7668        let body = axum::body::to_bytes(second.into_body(), 1024 * 1024)
7669            .await
7670            .unwrap();
7671        let body = String::from_utf8_lossy(&body);
7672        assert_eq!(
7673            status,
7674            StatusCode::FORBIDDEN,
7675            "rotated completion spend must be refused by the principal ledger; got {status}: {body}"
7676        );
7677        assert!(
7678            body.contains("principal.max_tokens"),
7679            "refusal must name the principal-scoped limit: {body}"
7680        );
7681        server.abort();
7682    }

7684    /// Pins the upstream Authorization wire contract per posture — the
7685    /// README/doctor headline claim "the key is injected server-side".
7686    /// Verified first against the real binary with a header-capturing
7687    /// upstream (register item 17, pass 15); this test keeps the three
7688    /// postures pinned in-tree:
7689    ///   * keyless + ignore_client_authorization: the client's
7690    ///     placeholder bearer is DISCARDED (no Authorization upstream);
7691    ///   * static key file: upstream sees the SERVER key, never the
7692    ///     client's junk;
7693    ///   * passthrough: the client's own bearer travels verbatim.
7694    /// The allowlist relay (openai-beta) and non-allowlisted header
7695    /// blocking (x-custom-header) ride along in every posture.
7696    #[tokio::test]
7697    async fn upstream_authorization_contract_by_posture() {
7698        type Captured = Arc<parking_lot::Mutex<Vec<(Option<String>, Option<String>, Option<String>)>>>;
7699        for posture in ["keyless_ignore", "static_key_file", "passthrough"] {
7700            let directory = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
7701            let captured: Captured = Arc::default();
7702            let sink = Arc::clone(&captured);
7703            let listener = tokio::net::TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").await.unwrap();
7704            let address = listener.local_addr().unwrap();
7705            let provider = Router::new().route(
7706                "/v1/chat/completions",
7707                post(
7708                    move |headers: axum::http::HeaderMap, Json(payload): Json<Value>| {
7709                        let sink = Arc::clone(&sink);
7710                        async move {
7711                            let get = |name: &str| {
7712                                headers.get(name).and_then(|v| v.to_str().ok()).map(str::to_owned)
7713                            };
7714                            sink.lock().push((
7715                                get("authorization"),
7716                                get("openai-beta"),
7717                                get("x-custom-header"),
7718                            ));
7719                            mock_chat(Json(payload)).await
7720                        }
7721                    },
7722                ),
7723            );
7724            let server = tokio::spawn(async move {
7725                axum::serve(listener, provider).await.unwrap();
7726            });
7727            let spool = directory.path().to_string_lossy().into_owned();
7728            let mut config =
7729                crate::config::HarnessConfig::for_tests(&format!("http://{address}"), &spool, &spool);
7730            match posture {
7731                "keyless_ignore" => config.ignore_client_authorization = true,
7732                "static_key_file" => {
7733                    let key_path = directory.path().join("upstream.key");
7734                    std::fs::write(&key_path, "sk-SERVER-SECRET").unwrap();
7735                    #[cfg(unix)]
7736                    {
7737                        use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt as _;
7738                        std::fs::set_permissions(&key_path, std::fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o600)).unwrap();
7739                    }
7740                    config.upstream_api_key_file = Some(key_path.to_string_lossy().into_owned());
7741                }
7742                "passthrough" => config.upstream_authorization_passthrough = true,
7743                _ => unreachable!(),
7744            }
7745            let state = AppState::new(
7746                config,
7747                Arc::new(InMemoryStore::new()),
7748                Arc::new(Sandbox::new(SandboxConfig::default(), Vec::new()).unwrap()),
7749                Arc::new(NullBus),
7750                None,
7751                Arc::new(Ed25519Signer::from_seed(&[11; 32])),
7752            )
7753            .unwrap();
7754            let request = Request::builder()
7755                .method("POST")
7756                .uri("/v1/chat/completions")
7757                .header(axum::http::header::CONTENT_TYPE, "application/json")
7758                .header("authorization", "Bearer sk-CLIENT-JUNK")
7759                .header("openai-beta", "assistants=v2")
7760                .header("x-custom-header", "evil")
7761                .header("x-pv-session", format!("auth-{posture}"))
7762                .header("x-pv-workflow", "unsigned")
7763                .body(Body::from(serde_json::to_vec(&chat_payload()).unwrap()))
7764                .unwrap();
7765            let response = build_router(state).oneshot(request).await.unwrap();
7766            assert_eq!(response.status(), StatusCode::OK, "posture {posture} must serve");
7767            axum::body::to_bytes(response.into_body(), 1024 * 1024)
7768                .await
7769                .unwrap();
7770            let seen = captured.lock().clone();
7771            let (auth, beta, custom) = seen
7772                .first()
7773                .cloned()
7774                .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("posture {posture}: upstream never saw the request"));
7775            match posture {
7776                "keyless_ignore" => assert_eq!(
7777                    auth, None,
7778                    "keyless posture must DISCARD the client placeholder bearer"
7779                ),
7780                "static_key_file" => assert_eq!(
7781                    auth.as_deref(),
7782                    Some("Bearer sk-SERVER-SECRET"),
7783                    "static-key posture must inject the server key, never the client's"
7784                ),
7785                "passthrough" => assert_eq!(
7786                    auth.as_deref(),
7787                    Some("Bearer sk-CLIENT-JUNK"),
7788                    "passthrough posture must forward the client bearer verbatim"
7789                ),
7790                _ => unreachable!(),
7791            }
7792            assert_eq!(
7793                beta.as_deref(),
7794                Some("assistants=v2"),
7795                "posture {posture}: allowlisted provider header must relay"
7796            );
7797            assert_eq!(
7798                custom, None,
7799                "posture {posture}: non-allowlisted client headers must never reach the upstream"
7800            );
7801            server.abort();
7802        }
7803    }

7805    /// Live-stress finding: deterministic fail-closed lifecycle
7806    /// refusals (quarantined capture, unfulfillable promotion) used to
7807    /// surface as HTTP 500 — SDKs retried them pointlessly and 5xx-rate
7808    /// pagers fired on working policy. They must map to 409 Conflict,
7809    /// mirroring the tool path's state-conflict convention.
7810    #[tokio::test]
7811    async fn quarantined_session_close_and_promote_map_to_conflict_not_500() {
7812        let directory = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
7813        let (state, provider) = test_state(directory.path()).await;
7814        let app = build_router(state.clone());
7815        // Open a session, then quarantine it (capture failed).
7816        let opened = app.clone().oneshot(chat_request("quarantine-409")).await.unwrap();
7817        assert_eq!(opened.status(), StatusCode::OK);
7818        axum::body::to_bytes(opened.into_body(), 1024 * 1024)
7819            .await
7820            .unwrap();
7821        let session = state.sessions.get("quarantine-409").unwrap();
7822        session.wait_for_worker_jobs().await;
7823        session.mark_capture_failed();
7824
7825        let close = app
7826            .clone()
7827            .oneshot(
7828                Request::builder()
7829                    .method("POST")
7830                    .uri("/v1/sessions/quarantine-409/close")
7831                    .body(Body::empty())
7832                    .unwrap(),
7833            )
7834            .await
7835            .unwrap();
7836        assert_eq!(
7837            close.status(),
7838            StatusCode::CONFLICT,
7839            "capture-incomplete close refusal is a state conflict, not a server fault"
7840        );
7841        let promote = app
7842            .oneshot(
7843                Request::builder()
7844                    .method("POST")
7845                    .uri("/v1/sessions/quarantine-409/promote")
7846                    .body(Body::empty())
7847                    .unwrap(),
7848            )
7849            .await
7850            .unwrap();
7851        assert_eq!(
7852            promote.status(),
7853            StatusCode::CONFLICT,
7854            "unfulfillable promotion refusal is a state conflict, not a server fault"
7855        );
7856        provider.abort();
7857    }

7896    /// `/v1/chat/completions` must
7897    /// refuse duplicate top-level or nested JSON keys, mirroring the
7898    /// MCP path's `parse_tool_call` policy. `serde_json`'s default
7899    /// last-wins semantics would otherwise let a hostile client
7900    /// send `{"messages":[safe],"messages":[hostile]}` and the
7901    /// harness would see the hostile array while any auditor reading
7902    /// the raw request bytes sees the ambiguous document. Same
7903    /// class as the receipt-null malleability, applied at
7904    /// chat ingress.
7905    #[tokio::test]
7906    async fn chat_completions_refuses_duplicate_json_keys() {
7907        let directory = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
7908        let (state, provider) = test_state(directory.path()).await;
7909        let app = build_router(state.clone());
7910        // Two `messages` keys in the top-level object; second wins by
7911        // `serde_json` default, but the harness must refuse ambiguity
7912        // instead of silently taking the last value.
7913        let dup = br#"{"model":"mock","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"safe"}],"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hostile"}]}"#;
7914        let request = Request::builder()
7915            .method("POST")
7916            .uri("/v1/chat/completions")
7917            .header(axum::http::header::CONTENT_TYPE, "application/json")
7918            .header("x-pv-session", "dup-key")
7919            .header("x-pv-workflow", "unsigned")
7920            .body(Body::from(&dup[..]))
7921            .unwrap();
7922        let response = app.oneshot(request).await.unwrap();
7923        assert_eq!(
7924            response.status(),
7925            StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST,
7926            "duplicate `messages` key must be refused with 400, not silently taken"
7927        );
7928        let body = axum::body::to_bytes(response.into_body(), 4 * 1024)
7929            .await
7930            .unwrap();
7931        let text = std::str::from_utf8(&body).unwrap();
7932        assert!(
7933            text.contains("duplicate"),
7934            "response body must name the reason, got {text:?}"
7935        );
7936        provider.abort();
7937    }

7939    fn active_records(
7940        directory: &std::path::Path,
7941        state: &AppState,

7944        let digest = pv_core::digest::sha256_hex(session_id.as_bytes());

7950            .map(|(index, line)| {
7951                crate::journal::open(
7952                    &state.journal_key,
7953                    &format!("{session_id}:active"),
7954                    index as u64,
7955                    line.as_bytes(),
7956                )
7957                .unwrap()
7958            })
7959            .collect()
7960    }

7989        assert_eq!(

8035        let receipt: pv_receipts::Receipt = serde_json::from_slice(
8036            &axum::body::to_bytes(promoted.into_body(), 64 * 1024)
8037                .await
8038                .unwrap(),
8039        )
8040        .unwrap();
8041        receipt.verify_embedded().unwrap();
8042        assert_eq!(receipt.body.stop_reason_id, pv_events::StopReason::Stop.id());
8043        assert_eq!(receipt.body.cost.completion_tokens, 3);
8044        assert_eq!(receipt.body.cost.cached_tokens, 4);
8045        assert_eq!(receipt.body.cost.cost_usd_micros, 1_250);
8046        assert_eq!(
8047            receipt.body.cost.prompt_tokens, 10,
8048            "prompt total must reconcile to the provider-reported usage, \
8049             not the admission-time heuristic (and never both summed)"
8050        );
8051        provider.abort();

8054    #[tokio::test]
8055    async fn mcp_metrics_and_abort_paths_are_enforced() {
8056        let directory = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
8057        let (state, provider) = test_state(directory.path()).await;
8058        let app = build_router(state.clone());
8059        let allowed = app

8062                Request::builder()
8063                    .method("POST")
8064                    .uri("/v1/mcp")
8065                    .header("x-pv-session", "mcp-flow")
8066                    .body(Body::from(
8067                        r#"{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"read","arguments":{}}}"#,
8068                    ))
8069                    .unwrap(),
8070            )
8071            .await
8072            .unwrap();
8073        assert_eq!(allowed.status(), StatusCode::OK);
8074        let allowed_body: Value = serde_json::from_slice(
8075            &axum::body::to_bytes(allowed.into_body(), 64 * 1024)
8076                .await
8077                .unwrap(),
8078        )
8079        .unwrap();
8080        // The ack is a conformant JSON-RPC
8081        // response now — id echoed, result envelope present.
8082        assert_eq!(allowed_body["jsonrpc"], "2.0");
8083        assert_eq!(allowed_body["id"], 1);
8084        assert!(allowed_body["result"]["decision_us"].as_u64().unwrap() < 5_000);
8085
8086        let blocked = app
8087            .clone()
8088            .oneshot(
8089                Request::builder()
8090                    .method("POST")
8091                    .uri("/v1/mcp")
8092                    .header("x-pv-session", "mcp-flow")
8093                    .body(Body::from("not-json"))
8094                    .unwrap(),
8095            )
8096            .await
8097            .unwrap();
8098        // Invalid JSON is a protocol
8099        // failure (-32700 / HTTP 400), not a policy decision (403).
8100        assert_eq!(blocked.status(), StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST);
8101        let blocked_body: Value = serde_json::from_slice(
8102            &axum::body::to_bytes(blocked.into_body(), 64 * 1024)
8103                .await
8104                .unwrap(),
8105        )
8106        .unwrap();
8107        assert_eq!(blocked_body["error"]["code"], -32700);
8108
8109        let metrics_response = app
8110            .clone()
8111            .oneshot(Request::builder().uri("/metrics").body(Body::empty()).unwrap())
8112            .await
8113            .unwrap();
8114        let metrics = String::from_utf8_lossy(
8115            &axum::body::to_bytes(metrics_response.into_body(), 128 * 1024)
8116                .await
8117                .unwrap(),
8118        )
8119        .into_owned();
8120        assert!(metrics.contains("pv_stage_duration_seconds") || metrics.contains("pv_sessions"));
8121
8122        let aborted = app.clone().oneshot(chat_request("abort-flow")).await.unwrap();
8123        drop(aborted);
8124        // A client abort AFTER content was captured (the
8125        // SSE peek already consumed the first frame) must NOT force-close
8126        // the conversation — the turn is recorded and the session stays
8127        // open for the client's next request; the idle sweeper owns
8128        // eventual finalization. Only a nothing-captured one-shot abort
8129        // spawns the background close.
8130        let session = tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(1), async {
8131            loop {
8132                if let Some(session) = state.sessions.get("abort-flow") {
8133                    if session.active_streams_count() == 0 {
8134                        break session;
8135                    }
8136                }
8137                tokio::task::yield_now().await;
8138            }
8139        })
8140        .await
8141        .expect("abort stream never drained");
8142        assert!(
8143            !session.is_closed(),
8144            "an abort after captured content must leave the conversation open"
8145        );
8146        provider.abort();
8147    }

8149    /// The response-body stream drops mid-flight while another task is
8150    /// closing the session (idle timeout or explicit close). Recorded
8151    /// scenario: `try_close` in `close_session_locked` transitions
8152    /// `closed` 0→1, then blocks in `wait_for_streams` because the
8153    /// client still holds the response body's `SessionLease`. When
8154    /// the client eventually drops the response, `AbortFinalizingStream::drop`
8155    /// used to see `session.is_closed() == true` and return early —
8156    /// silently skipping `submit_response_capture`. The reader's
8157    /// response bytes never reached the chain, but `wait_for_streams`
8158    /// then unblocked and the finalize path signed a receipt whose
8159    /// `subject.event_count` reflects only the compression event.
8160    #[tokio::test]
8161    async fn stream_drop_during_concurrent_close_still_captures_response() {
8162        let directory = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
8163        let (state, provider) = test_state(directory.path()).await;
8164        let app = build_router(state.clone());
8165
8166        let request = Request::builder()
8167            .method("POST")
8168            .uri("/v1/chat/completions")
8169            .header(axum::http::header::CONTENT_TYPE, "application/json")
8170            .header("x-pv-session", "stream-close-race")
8171            .header("x-pv-workflow", "signed")
8172            .body(Body::from(serde_json::to_vec(&chat_payload()).unwrap()))
8173            .unwrap();
8174        let response = app.oneshot(request).await.unwrap();
8175        assert_eq!(response.status(), StatusCode::OK);
8176
8177        let session = state.sessions.get("stream-close-race").unwrap();
8178
8179        let close_task = {
8180            let finalizer = state.finalizer.clone();
8181            let session = Arc::clone(&session);
8182            tokio::spawn(async move { finalizer.close_session(session, StopReason::SessionClosed).await })
8183        };
8184
8185        tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(1), async {
8186            while !session.is_closed() {
8187                tokio::task::yield_now().await;
8188            }
8189        })
8190        .await
8191        .expect("concurrent close did not initiate before the response was dropped");
8192
8193        drop(response);
8194
8195        close_task
8196            .await
8197            .expect("close_session task panicked")
8198            .expect("close_session returned an error");
8199
8200        let final_count = session.chain.lock().count();
8201        assert!(
8202            final_count >= 2,
8203            "AbortFinalizingStream::drop must submit the response capture even when the session is already being closed — otherwise a concurrent close during an active stream discards the response and the receipt attests to fewer events than actually flowed; got chain.count() = {final_count}",
8204        );
8205
8206        provider.abort();
8207    }

8209    /// Regression for the follow-on to the concurrent-close capture bug. The
8210    /// original fix removed the `is_closed()` early-return from
8211    /// `AbortFinalizingStream::drop` so the response capture would still be
8212    /// submitted while another task drained the stream via
8213    /// `wait_for_streams`. But `drop` also carried a defensive
8214    /// `if self.pending_budget.is_some() { self.session.mark_capture_failed(); }`
8215    /// intended for genuine abort-mid-flight: an in-flight completion-token
8216    /// budget task means we don't yet know if the token spend would have been
8217    /// refused, so fail-closed is safe for a normal client disconnect. When
8218    /// composed with the removal of the `is_closed()` early-return, however,
8219    /// this fail-closed mark now fires during the concurrent-close scenario
8220    /// too — even though the concurrent close is imminent and skipping the
8221    /// last budget verdict is harmless (the response bytes are captured
8222    /// internally regardless of whether we would have emitted them to the
8223    /// client). The resulting `capture_failed = 1` then makes the concurrent
8224    /// close's post-`wait_for_worker_jobs` `if session.capture_failed()` guard
8225    /// seal the session (`mark_artifact_committed` + committed claim) and
8226    /// return `Err(FinalizeError::CaptureIncomplete)`: the close is not
8227    /// retried, and the session finalizes without any artifact — the
8228    /// capture is silently lost. The fix: gate the pending-budget mark
8229    /// (and the budget-delta > 0 mark and the flush-error mark) on
8230    /// `!is_closed`, so during a concurrent close the drop submits the
8231    /// response capture without fail-closing the session.
8232    #[tokio::test]
8233    async fn drop_with_pending_budget_during_concurrent_close_does_not_stick_session() {
8234        let directory = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
8235        let (state, provider) = test_state(directory.path()).await;
8236
8237        let identity = pv_events::AgentIdentity {
8238            version: "1".into(),
8239            charter: "c".into(),
8240            instance_uid: "i".into(),
8241            ttl_remaining_s: None,
8242        };
8243        let session = state.sessions.get_or_open(
8244            "pending-budget-close",
8245            crate::session::Workflow::Signed,
8246            &identity,
8247            &state.config.breaker,
8248        );
8249        // Reserve a full permit pair up front (worker slot + response
8250        // slot) so `submit_response_capture` in drop has somewhere to
8251        // send the job; the response permit lives on
8252        // `AbortFinalizingStream` for the stream's lifetime.
8253        let permits = state
8254            .worker
8255            .try_reserve_pair("pending-budget-close")
8256            .expect("test setup: fused worker/response permit");
8257        // The worker permit is dropped here — the test does not
8258        // actually submit a job through it; the response permit is
8259        // what the stream drop cares about.
8260        drop(permits.worker);
8261        let permit = permits.response;
8262        // Bump active_streams so a concurrent close would block in
8263        // `wait_for_streams`, mirroring the production scenario.
8264        let lease = crate::session::SessionLease::new(Arc::clone(&session));
8265
8266        // Set up an in-flight budget task. Its result is irrelevant to drop —
8267        // drop only checks `pending_budget.is_some()` — but the JoinHandle
8268        // has to be a real one so the field type-checks.
8269        let budget_task =
8270            tokio::spawn(async { Ok::<_, String>(pv_state::BudgetDecision::Allowed { remaining: 100 }) });
8271
8272        let stream = AbortFinalizingStream {
8273            inner: futures::stream::empty::<Result<Bytes, std::io::Error>>().boxed(),
8274            session: Arc::clone(&session),
8275            identity: identity.clone(),
8276            response_permit: Some(permit),
8277            worker: state.worker.clone(),
8278            store: Arc::clone(&state.store),
8279            budget: state.config.budget.clone(),
8280            rates: Arc::clone(&state.pushed_rates),
8281            pushed: state.sandbox.pushed(),
8282            local_budget: state.config.budget.clone(),
8283            failure_policy: None,
8284            emitted_any: false,
8285            egress_scanned: std::collections::BTreeMap::new(),
8286            egress_scanned_reasoning: std::collections::BTreeMap::new(),
8287            egress_scanned_tools: std::collections::BTreeMap::new(),
8288            hold_stream: false,
8289            held_frames: Vec::new(),
8290            egress_transforms: Vec::new(),
8291            billed_prompt_tokens: 0,
8292            principal_budget: None,
8293            finalizer: state.finalizer.clone(),
8294            _lease: lease,
8295            response_marker: None,
8296            response_attempt_id: "pending-budget-attempt".into(),
8297            response_choices: captured_choice("captured content", Some("stop")),
8298            response_model: None,
8299            upstream_status: StatusCode::OK,
8300            response_cost_usd_micros: 0,
8301            response_tool_calls: std::collections::BTreeMap::new(),
8302            response_metrics: pv_events::EventMetrics::default(),
8303            charged_completion_tokens: 3,
8304            last_reported_completion_tokens: Some(3),
8305            last_reported_prompt_tokens: None,
8306            last_reported_cached_tokens: None,
8307            last_reported_cost_usd_micros: None,
8308            saw_chunk: true,
8309            capture_attempted: false,
8310            is_sse: true,
8311            protocol_buffer: Vec::new(),
8312            frame_scratch: Vec::new(),
8313            pending_output: std::collections::VecDeque::new(),
8314            pending_budget: Some(PendingBudget {
8315                task: budget_task,
8316                continuation: BudgetContinuation::FinishSse,
8317                delta: 0,
8318            }),
8319            captured_bytes: 100,
8320            completed: false,
8321            ephemeral: false,
8322        };
8323
8324        // Simulate the concurrent close's `try_close` having already fired.
8325        assert!(session.try_close(), "test setup: try_close should have won");
8326        assert!(session.is_closed());
8327
8328        // Drop the stream. This is what happens when the response body is
8329        // released while another task is blocked in `wait_for_streams`.
8330        drop(stream);
8331
8332        assert!(
8333            !session.capture_failed(),
8334            "AbortFinalizingStream::drop must not fail the capture just because a completion-token budget check was still in flight while a concurrent close is already draining this stream via wait_for_streams — otherwise close_session_locked's capture_failed guard seals the session and returns CaptureIncomplete: the receipt is never signed and the capture is lost",
8335        );
8336
8337        // Now run the concurrent close to completion. It must succeed —
8338        // wait_for_streams sees active=0 (lease dropped), wait_for_worker_jobs
8339        // drains the response job we just submitted, and the capture_failed
8340        // check must find `false` so the finalize path can proceed to
8341        // sign the receipt.
8342        let outcome = tokio::time::timeout(
8343            Duration::from_secs(3),
8344            state
8345                .finalizer
8346                .close_session(Arc::clone(&session), StopReason::SessionClosed),
8347        )
8348        .await
8349        .expect("close_session hung after drop released the stream");
8350        outcome.expect(
8351            "close_session must succeed after AbortFinalizingStream::drop submits the response capture — a session sealed without its artifact is worse than a marginally-over-budget response record, because the receipt is lost entirely",
8352        );
8353
8354        provider.abort();
8355    }

8357    /// A network chunk's frame deltas are debited ONCE after the drain
8358    /// loop, but `absorb_frame` bumps `charged_completion_tokens` per
8359    /// frame. An error on a later frame in the same chunk abandons the
8360    /// never-debited delta — without a rollback, the terminal refund
8361    /// (`charged − reported`) credited tokens that were never debited,
8362    /// letting a hostile upstream replenish the session ledger at will.
8363    #[tokio::test]
8364    async fn absorb_error_rolls_back_undebited_completion_charges() {
8365        let directory = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();

8367        let identity = pv_events::AgentIdentity {
8368            version: "1".into(),

8370            instance_uid: "i".into(),

8372        };

8374            "absorb-rollback",
8375            crate::session::Workflow::Signed,
8376            &identity,
8377            &state.config.breaker,
8378        );
8379        let lease = crate::session::SessionLease::new(Arc::clone(&session));
8380        let mut stream = AbortFinalizingStream {
8381            inner: futures::stream::empty::<Result<Bytes, std::io::Error>>().boxed(),
8382            session: Arc::clone(&session),
8383            identity,
8384            response_permit: None,
8385            worker: state.worker.clone(),
8386            store: Arc::clone(&state.store),
8387            budget: state.config.budget.clone(),
8388            rates: Arc::clone(&state.pushed_rates),
8389            pushed: state.sandbox.pushed(),
8390            local_budget: state.config.budget.clone(),
8391            failure_policy: None,
8392            emitted_any: false,
8393            egress_scanned: std::collections::BTreeMap::new(),
8394            egress_scanned_reasoning: std::collections::BTreeMap::new(),
8395            egress_scanned_tools: std::collections::BTreeMap::new(),
8396            hold_stream: false,
8397            held_frames: Vec::new(),
8398            egress_transforms: Vec::new(),
8399            billed_prompt_tokens: 0,
8400            principal_budget: None,
8401            finalizer: state.finalizer.clone(),
8402            _lease: lease,
8403            response_marker: None,
8404            response_attempt_id: "absorb-rollback-attempt".into(),
8405            response_choices: std::collections::BTreeMap::new(),
8406            response_model: None,
8407            upstream_status: StatusCode::OK,
8408            response_cost_usd_micros: 0,
8409            response_tool_calls: std::collections::BTreeMap::new(),
8410            response_metrics: pv_events::EventMetrics::default(),
8411            charged_completion_tokens: 0,
8412            last_reported_completion_tokens: None,
8413            last_reported_prompt_tokens: None,
8414            last_reported_cached_tokens: None,
8415            last_reported_cost_usd_micros: None,
8416            saw_chunk: false,
8417            capture_attempted: true,
8418            is_sse: true,
8419            protocol_buffer: Vec::new(),
8420            frame_scratch: Vec::new(),
8421            pending_output: std::collections::VecDeque::new(),
8422            pending_budget: None,
8423            captured_bytes: 0,
8424            completed: false,
8425            ephemeral: false,
8426        };
8427        // Frame A: content without usage → the estimate branch bumps
8428        // `charged_completion_tokens`. Frame B: malformed JSON → error.
8429        // Both frames arrive in ONE network chunk, so frame A's delta
8430        // was never debited.
8431        let chunk = concat!(
8432            "data: {\"choices\":[{\"index\":0,\"delta\":{\"content\":\"some streamed words here\"}}]}\n\n",
8433            "data: {not-json\n\n",
8434        );
8435        let result = stream.absorb_network_chunk(chunk.as_bytes());
8436        assert!(result.is_err(), "the malformed frame must fail the chunk");
8437        assert_eq!(
8438            stream.charged_completion_tokens, 0,
8439            "an errored chunk's never-debited frame deltas must be rolled back \
8440             from charged_completion_tokens, or the terminal refund credits \
8441             tokens that were never debited"
8442        );
8443        provider.abort();
8444    }

8551    /// budget. `capture_attempted: true` short-circuits
8552    /// `submit_response_capture` in drop so the test needs no worker
8553    /// permits — the branch under test is the background auto-close spawn.
8554    fn empty_abort_stream(
