8583            response_marker: None,
8584            response_attempt_id: "empty-abort-attempt".into(),
8585            response_choices: std::collections::BTreeMap::new(),
8586            response_model: None,
8587            upstream_status: StatusCode::OK,
8588            response_cost_usd_micros: 0,

8596            saw_chunk: false,

8599            protocol_buffer: Vec::new(),
8600            frame_scratch: Vec::new(),
8601            pending_output: std::collections::VecDeque::new(),
8602            pending_budget: None,
8603            captured_bytes: 0,
8604            completed: false,
8605            ephemeral,
8606        }
8607    }

8609    /// A NON-ephemeral session (client sent `X-PV-Session`) whose turn
8610    /// aborts before any upstream byte arrives must stay OPEN.
8611    /// OPENAI-COMPATIBILITY.md: multi-turn sessions close only via
8612    /// explicit `POST /close` or the idle sweeper. Pre-fix, the
8613    /// abort-cleanup spawn at the bottom of `Drop` was missing the
8614    /// `ephemeral` gate its completed-arm sibling has, so an ordinary
8615    /// network blip on turn N force-closed the whole session with
8616    /// `StopReason::Other`; the client's retry with the same string id
8617    /// silently opened a NEW session (get_or_open sees close_complete),
8618    /// fragmenting the audit chain into disjoint signed records.
8619    #[tokio::test]
8620    async fn non_ephemeral_empty_abort_leaves_session_open() {
8621        let directory = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
8622        let (state, provider) = test_state(directory.path()).await;
8623        let identity = pv_events::AgentIdentity {
8624            version: "1".into(),
8625            charter: "c".into(),
8626            instance_uid: "i".into(),
8627            ttl_remaining_s: None,
8628        };
8629        let session = state.sessions.get_or_open(
8630            "client-managed-multi-turn",
8631            crate::session::Workflow::Signed,
8632            &identity,
8633            &state.config.breaker,
8634        );
8635        let stream = empty_abort_stream(&state, &session, identity, false);
8636        drop(stream);
8637        // Give an (erroneously) spawned background close every chance to
8638        // run before asserting: yield through the runtime a few times.
8639        for _ in 0..20 {
8640            tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10)).await;
8641            if session.is_closed() {
8642                break;
8643            }
8644        }
8645        assert!(
8646            !session.is_closed(),
8647            "a client-managed (non-ephemeral) session must NOT be auto-closed \
8648             when a turn aborts with nothing captured — multi-turn sessions \
8649             close only via POST /close or the idle sweeper, otherwise the \
8650             client's retry with the same id fragments the audit chain"
8651        );
8652        provider.abort();
8653    }
8654
8655    /// The intended reaping path still works: an EPHEMERAL one-shot whose
8656    /// turn aborts with nothing captured is closed in the background so
8657    /// it does not linger as an empty husk until the idle sweeper.
8658    #[tokio::test]
8659    async fn ephemeral_empty_abort_closes_session_in_background() {
8660        let directory = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
8661        let (state, provider) = test_state(directory.path()).await;
8662        let identity = pv_events::AgentIdentity {
8663            version: "1".into(),
8664            charter: "c".into(),
8665            instance_uid: "i".into(),
8666            ttl_remaining_s: None,
8667        };
8668        let session = state.sessions.get_or_open(
8669            "ephemeral-empty-abort",
8670            crate::session::Workflow::Signed,
8671            &identity,
8672            &state.config.breaker,
8673        );
8674        let stream = empty_abort_stream(&state, &session, identity, true);
8675        drop(stream);
8676        let deadline = tokio::time::Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(3);
8677        while !session.is_closed() && tokio::time::Instant::now() < deadline {
8678            tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10)).await;
8679        }
8680        assert!(
8681            session.is_closed(),
8682            "an ephemeral one-shot aborted before any upstream byte must be \
8683             closed by the background abort-cleanup spawn, not linger until \
8684             the idle sweeper"
8685        );
8686        provider.abort();
8687    }

8689    #[tokio::test]
8690    async fn duplicate_tool_id_replays_outcome_without_reexecution() {
8691        let tool_listener = tokio::net::TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").await.unwrap();
8692        let tool_address = tool_listener.local_addr().unwrap();
8693        let calls = Arc::new(std::sync::atomic::AtomicUsize::new(0));
8694        let tool_router = Router::new()
8695            .route("/mcp", post(counting_tool))
8696            .with_state(Arc::clone(&calls));
8697        let tool_server = tokio::spawn(async move {

8701        let (mut state, provider) = test_state(directory.path()).await;
8702        Arc::get_mut(&mut state.config).unwrap().tool_upstream_url =
8703            Some(format!("http://{tool_address}/mcp"));
8704        let app = build_router(state.clone());
8705        let body = r#"{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":"once","method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"read","arguments":{"id":7}}}"#;
8706        for _ in 0..2 {
8707            let response = app
8708                .clone()
8709                .oneshot(
8710                    Request::builder()
8711                        .method("POST")
8712                        .uri("/v1/mcp")

8718                .unwrap();

8723                    .unwrap(),

8725            );
8726        }
8727        assert_eq!(calls.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Acquire), 1);
8728        let session = state.sessions.get("tool-once").unwrap();

8730            session
8731                .totals
8732                .tool_calls
8733                .load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Acquire),

8735        );
8736        let audited_path = std::fs::read_dir(directory.path().join(crate::spool::TOOL_EXECUTIONS))
8737            .unwrap()
8738            .map(|entry| entry.unwrap().path())
8739            .find(|path| path.extension().is_some_and(|extension| extension == "audited"))
8740            .unwrap();
8741        std::fs::remove_file(audited_path).unwrap();
8742        let unaudited_replay = app
8743            .clone()
8744            .oneshot(
8745                Request::builder()
8746                    .method("POST")
8747                    .uri("/v1/mcp")
8748                    .header("x-pv-session", "tool-once")
8749                    .body(Body::from(body))
8750                    .unwrap(),
8751            )
8752            .await
8753            .unwrap();
8754        assert_eq!(unaudited_replay.status(), StatusCode::OK);
8755        assert_eq!(calls.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Acquire), 1);
8756        assert_eq!(
8757            session
8758                .totals
8759                .tool_calls
8760                .load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Acquire),
8761            1,
8762            "unaudited outcome recovery must not spend tool budget again"
8763        );
8764
8765        let changed_request = app
8766            .clone()
8767            .oneshot(
8768                Request::builder()
8769                    .method("POST")
8770                    .uri("/v1/mcp")
8771                    .header("x-pv-session", "tool-once")
8772                    .body(Body::from(
8773                        r#"{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":"once","method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"read","arguments":{"id":8}}}"#,
8774                    ))
8775                    .unwrap(),
8776            )
8777            .await
8778            .unwrap();
8779        assert_eq!(changed_request.status(), StatusCode::CONFLICT);
8780        assert_eq!(calls.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Acquire), 1);
8781        tool_server.abort();
8782        provider.abort();

8785    /// End-to-end proof that a configured upstream API key is injected on
8786    /// the upstream wire: a capturing mock provider records the header the
8787    /// harness actually sent for both Bearer and Azure raw-key styles, and
8788    /// the passthrough mode relays the client's own Authorization header.
8789    #[tokio::test]
8790    async fn upstream_auth_header_reaches_provider_wire() {
8791        type Captured = Arc<parking_lot::Mutex<Vec<(Option<String>, Option<String>)>>>;
8792        async fn capture_chat(
8793            State(captured): State<Captured>,
8794            headers: HeaderMap,
8795            Json(_): Json<Value>,
8796        ) -> Response {
8797            captured.lock().push((
8798                headers
8799                    .get(axum::http::header::AUTHORIZATION)
8800                    .and_then(|value| value.to_str().ok())
8801                    .map(str::to_owned),
8802                headers
8803                    .get("api-key")
8804                    .and_then(|value| value.to_str().ok())
8805                    .map(str::to_owned),
8806            ));
8807            Json(json!({"choices": [], "usage": {"prompt_tokens": 1, "completion_tokens": 1}}))
8808                .into_response()
8809        }
8810        let captured: Captured = Arc::new(parking_lot::Mutex::new(Vec::new()));
8811        let listener = tokio::net::TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").await.unwrap();
8812        let address = listener.local_addr().unwrap();
8813        let provider_router = Router::new()
8814            .route("/v1/chat/completions", post(capture_chat))
8815            .route("/openai/deployments/d1/chat/completions", post(capture_chat))
8816            .with_state(Arc::clone(&captured));
8817        let provider = tokio::spawn(async move {
8818            axum::serve(listener, provider_router).await.unwrap();
8819        });
8820        let directory = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
8821        let key_path = directory.path().join("upstream.key");
8822        std::fs::write(&key_path, "sk-wire-test\n").unwrap();
8823        #[cfg(unix)]
8824        {
8825            use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt as _;
8826            std::fs::set_permissions(&key_path, std::fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o600)).unwrap();
8827        }
8828        let spool = directory.path().to_string_lossy();
8829        let build_state = |config: crate::config::HarnessConfig| {
8830            AppState::new(
8831                config,
8832                Arc::new(InMemoryStore::new()),
8833                Arc::new(Sandbox::new(SandboxConfig::default(), Vec::new()).unwrap()),
8834                Arc::new(NullBus),
8835                None,
8836                Arc::new(Ed25519Signer::from_seed(&[12; 32])),
8837            )
8838            .unwrap()
8839        };
8840        let send_chat = |state: AppState, authorization: Option<&'static str>| async move {
8841            let mut request = Request::builder()
8842                .method("POST")
8843                .uri("/v1/chat/completions")
8844                .header(axum::http::header::CONTENT_TYPE, "application/json")
8845                .header("x-pv-session", "auth-wire");
8846            if let Some(value) = authorization {
8847                request = request.header(axum::http::header::AUTHORIZATION, value);
8848            }
8849            let response = build_router(state)
8850                .oneshot(request.body(Body::from(chat_payload().to_string())).unwrap())
8851                .await
8852                .unwrap();
8853            assert_eq!(response.status(), StatusCode::OK);
8854        };
8855
8856        // 1) Bearer key from an owner-only file.
8857        let mut config =
8858            crate::config::HarnessConfig::for_tests(&format!("http://{address}"), &spool, &spool);
8859        config.upstream_api_key_file = Some(key_path.to_string_lossy().into_owned());
8860        send_chat(build_state(config), None).await;
8861        assert_eq!(
8862            captured.lock().pop().unwrap(),
8863            (Some("Bearer sk-wire-test".to_owned()), None),
8864            "Bearer credential must reach the provider"
8865        );
8866
8867        // 2) Azure style: raw key in a custom header on a custom path.
8868        let mut config =
8869            crate::config::HarnessConfig::for_tests(&format!("http://{address}"), &spool, &spool);
8870        config.upstream_api_key_file = Some(key_path.to_string_lossy().into_owned());
8871        config.upstream_auth_header = "api-key".into();
8872        config.upstream_auth_scheme = String::new();
8873        config.upstream_chat_path = "/openai/deployments/d1/chat/completions".into();
8874        send_chat(build_state(config), None).await;
8875        assert_eq!(
8876            captured.lock().pop().unwrap(),
8877            (None, Some("sk-wire-test".to_owned())),
8878            "raw key must reach the provider on the configured path and header"
8879        );
8880
8881        // 3) Passthrough: the client's own Authorization header is relayed.
8882        let mut config =
8883            crate::config::HarnessConfig::for_tests(&format!("http://{address}"), &spool, &spool);
8884        config.upstream_authorization_passthrough = true;
8885        send_chat(build_state(config), Some("Bearer client-owned-key")).await;
8886        assert_eq!(
8887            captured.lock().pop().unwrap(),
8888            (Some("Bearer client-owned-key".to_owned()), None),
8889            "passthrough must relay the client credential"
8890        );
8891
8892        // 4) No identity validator configured but the client sent a
8893        //    bearer: refuse with 401 rather than record the request as
8894        //    anonymous (a repudiation vector — see resolve_identity's
8895        //    "bearer presented but validator not configured" arm).
8896        //    The response is the block; the fact that no wire capture
8897        //    landed also proves the credential does not leak.
8898        let config = crate::config::HarnessConfig::for_tests(&format!("http://{address}"), &spool, &spool);
8899        let request = Request::builder()
8900            .method("POST")
8901            .uri("/v1/chat/completions")
8902            .header(axum::http::header::CONTENT_TYPE, "application/json")
8903            .header("x-pv-session", "auth-wire")
8904            .header(axum::http::header::AUTHORIZATION, "Bearer client-owned-key")
8905            .body(Body::from(chat_payload().to_string()))
8906            .unwrap();
8907        let response = build_router(build_state(config)).oneshot(request).await.unwrap();
8908        assert_eq!(
8909            response.status(),
8910            StatusCode::UNAUTHORIZED,
8911            "presenting a bearer with no validator configured must be refused rather than \
8912             silently recorded as anonymous — that would let a signed request end up \
8913             attributed to `charter=anonymous` in the receipt"
8914        );
8915        assert!(
8916            captured.lock().is_empty(),
8917            "no credential must reach upstream when the request was refused"
8918        );
8919        provider.abort();
8920    }

8942        let tool_server = tokio::spawn(async move {

8944        });
8945        let directory = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
8946        let token_path = directory.path().join("mcp.token");
8947        std::fs::write(&token_path, "tool-secret\n").unwrap();
8948        #[cfg(unix)]

8950            use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt as _;

8952        }

8954        {

8961        let response = build_router(state)
8962            .oneshot(

8965                    .uri("/v1/mcp")
8966                    .header("x-pv-session", "tool-auth")
8967                    .body(Body::from(
8968                        r#"{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":"t1","method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"read","arguments":{}}}"#,
8969                    ))
8970                    .unwrap(),

8972            .await
8973            .unwrap();

8984    /// A claim creates and writes its intent in one turn of the folder,
8985    /// so a scan (which reads intents in turns) never finds it empty and
8986    /// moves it aside as torn while the call is still running.
8987    #[test]
8988    fn a_claimed_intent_is_never_seen_empty() {
8989        let directory = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
8990        let mut headers = HeaderMap::new();
8991        headers.insert("x-pv-session", HeaderValue::from_static("claim-turn"));
8992        let body =
8993            br#"{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":"c","method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"read","arguments":{}}}"#;
8994        let mut execution =
8995            ToolExecution::from_request(&directory.path().to_string_lossy(), &headers, body, [7; 32])
8996                .unwrap();
8997        execution
8998            .bind_principal(&pv_events::AgentIdentity {
8999                version: "dev".to_owned(),
9000                charter: "anonymous".into(),
9001                instance_uid: "anonymous".to_owned(),
9002                ttl_remaining_s: None,
9003            })
9004            .unwrap();
9005        std::fs::create_dir_all(execution.intent_path.parent().unwrap()).unwrap();
9006        let intent_path = execution.intent_path.clone();
9007        let claim = crate::spool::change_tool_executions(intent_path.parent().unwrap(), || {
9008            let claim = std::thread::spawn(move || execution.claim_sync());
9009            std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(100));
9010            assert!(!intent_path.exists(), "the claim waits for the turn");
9011            claim
9012        });
9013        assert!(claim.join().unwrap().is_ok());
9014        let bytes = crate::spool::read_tool_intent(&intent_path).unwrap();
9015        assert!(!bytes.is_empty(), "complete when it appears");
9016    }

9061    /// A planted oversize file in `tool-executions/` must not stall or
9062    /// OOM the recovery scan. Pre-fix the three recovery reads were
9063    /// unbounded `std::fs::read` (every other spool scan uses
9064    /// `read_capped`), and a multi-GB plant loaded fully into RAM on
9065    /// every boot. The cap-refused file must be quarantined like a torn
9066    /// intent — renamed out of the `.intent.json` glob — so the scan
9067    /// completes and never re-reads it.
9068    #[tokio::test]
9069    async fn oversize_tool_intent_is_quarantined_not_loaded() {
9070        let directory = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
9071        let control_key = [32; 32];
9072        let executions = directory.path().join(crate::spool::TOOL_EXECUTIONS);
9073        std::fs::create_dir_all(&executions).unwrap();
9074        let plant = executions.join("oversizekey.intent.json");
9075        // Just past the MAX_CONTROL_BYTES cap.
9076        std::fs::write(&plant, vec![b'x'; 1024 * 1024 + 1]).unwrap();
9077
9078        let unresolved = unresolved_tool_sessions(directory.path(), &control_key)
9079            .await
9080            .expect("an oversize plant must not abort the recovery scan");
9081        assert!(unresolved.is_empty(), "{unresolved:?}");
9082        assert!(
9083            !plant.exists(),
9084            "the oversize intent must be quarantined out of the scan glob"
9085        );
9086        let quarantined = std::fs::read_dir(&executions)
9087            .unwrap()
9088            .filter_map(Result::ok)
9089            .any(|entry| {
9090                entry
9091                    .file_name()
9092                    .to_str()
9093                    .is_some_and(|name| name.ends_with(".intent.torn"))
9094            });
9095        assert!(quarantined, "quarantined plant must stay on disk as evidence");
9096    }

9098    /// The cap-guard quarantine arm must stay scoped to cap-class
9099    /// refusals (oversize, non-regular). A GENUINE IO fault — here
9100    /// permission-denied — must still abort the scan loudly rather
9101    /// than silently quarantining evidence the operator could repair
9102    /// (a chmod mistake would otherwise destroy every pending tool
9103    /// intent on the next boot).
9104    #[cfg(unix)]
9105    #[tokio::test]
9106    async fn unreadable_tool_intent_aborts_the_scan_not_quarantines() {
9107        use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt as _;
9108        let directory = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
9109        let control_key = [33; 32];
9110        let executions = directory.path().join(crate::spool::TOOL_EXECUTIONS);
9111        std::fs::create_dir_all(&executions).unwrap();
9112        let unreadable = executions.join("unreadablekey.intent.json");
9113        std::fs::write(&unreadable, b"sealed-bytes").unwrap();
9114        std::fs::set_permissions(&unreadable, std::fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o000)).unwrap();
9115        if std::fs::read(&unreadable).is_ok() {
9116            // Running as root (CI containers): the premise doesn't hold.
9117            return;
9118        }
9119
9120        let outcome = unresolved_tool_sessions(directory.path(), &control_key).await;
9121        assert!(
9122            outcome.is_err(),
9123            "a permission fault must abort the scan, not quarantine evidence"
9124        );
9125        assert!(
9126            unreadable.exists(),
9127            "the unreadable intent must be left in place for the operator"
9128        );
9129    }

9131    struct BlockingRefundStore {
9132        inner: InMemoryStore,
9133        batches: parking_lot::Mutex<Vec<Vec<pv_state::Refund>>>,
9134        entered: tokio::sync::Notify,
9135        released: parking_lot::Mutex<bool>,
9136        wake: parking_lot::Condvar,
9137        fallback_used: std::sync::atomic::AtomicBool,
9138    }
9139
9140    impl StateStore for BlockingRefundStore {
9141        fn add(&self, key: &str, delta: u64) -> Result<u64, StateError> {
9142            self.inner.add(key, delta)
9143        }
9144
9145        fn get(&self, key: &str) -> Result<u64, StateError> {
9146            self.inner.get(key)
9147        }
9148
9149        fn try_spend(&self, key: &str, amount: u64, limit: u64) -> Result<bool, StateError> {
9150            self.inner.try_spend(key, amount, limit)
9151        }
9152
9153        fn try_spend_many(&self, spends: &[Spend]) -> Result<pv_state::TrySpendOutcome, StateError> {
9154            self.inner.try_spend_many(spends)
9155        }
9156
9157        fn remove(&self, key: &str) {
9158            self.inner.remove(key);
9159        }
9160
9161        fn refund_many(&self, refunds: &[pv_state::Refund]) {
9162            let first = {
9163                let mut batches = self.batches.lock();
9164                batches.push(refunds.to_vec());
9165                batches.len() == 1
9166            };
9167            if first {
9168                self.entered.notify_one();
9169                let deadline = std::time::Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(3);
9170                let mut released = self.released.lock();
9171                while !*released {
9172                    let remaining = deadline.saturating_duration_since(std::time::Instant::now());
9173                    if remaining.is_zero() || self.wake.wait_for(&mut released, remaining).timed_out() {
9174                        // Keep the pre-fix test finite when this blocking call
9175                        // incorrectly occupies the only Tokio runtime thread.
9176                        self.fallback_used
9177                            .store(true, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Release);
9178                        break;
9179                    }
9180                }
9181            }
9182            self.inner.refund_many(refunds);
9183        }
9184    }

9186    #[tokio::test(flavor = "current_thread")]
9187    async fn mcp_refund_keeps_reactor_live_and_survives_caller_cancellation() {
9188        let directory = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
9189        let listener = tokio::net::TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").await.unwrap();
9190        let address = listener.local_addr().unwrap();
9191        // A refused connection proves that no upstream tool effect occurred.
9192        drop(listener);
9193        let mut config = crate::config::HarnessConfig::for_tests(
9194            &format!("http://{address}"),
9195            &directory.path().to_string_lossy(),
9196            &directory.path().to_string_lossy(),
9197        );
9198        config.tool_upstream_url = Some(format!("http://{address}/mcp"));
9199        config.budget.max_total_tool_calls = Some(1);
9200        config.budget.max_tool_calls.insert("read".into(), 1);
9201        config.principal_budget = Some(config.budget.clone());
9202        config.allow_anonymous_principal_budget = true;
9203        config.mcp_concurrency = 1;
9204        let store = Arc::new(BlockingRefundStore {
9205            inner: InMemoryStore::new(),
9206            batches: parking_lot::Mutex::new(Vec::new()),
9207            entered: tokio::sync::Notify::new(),
9208            released: parking_lot::Mutex::new(false),
9209            wake: parking_lot::Condvar::new(),
9210            fallback_used: std::sync::atomic::AtomicBool::new(false),
9211        });
9212        let sandbox = Arc::new(
9213            Sandbox::new(
9214                SandboxConfig {
9215                    budget: config.budget.clone(),
9216                    ..SandboxConfig::default()
9217                },
9218                Vec::new(),
9219            )
9220            .unwrap(),
9221        );
9222        let state = AppState::new(
9223            config,
9224            store.clone(),
9225            sandbox,
9226            Arc::new(NullBus),
9227            None,
9228            Arc::new(Ed25519Signer::from_seed(&[11; 32])),
9229        )
9230        .unwrap();
9231        let app = build_router(state.clone());
9232        let request = || {
9233            Request::builder()
9234                .method("POST")
9235                .uri("/v1/mcp")
9236                .header("x-pv-session", "refund-cancel")
9237                .body(Body::from(
9238                    r#"{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":"refund","method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"read","arguments":{}}}"#,
9239                ))
9240                .unwrap()
9241        };
9242        let mut expected_keys = Vec::new();
9243        for prefix in [
9244            pv_state::ActionBudget::session_prefix("refund-cancel"),
9245            pv_state::ActionBudget::principal_prefix("anonymous"),
9246        ] {
9247            expected_keys.push(format!("{prefix}total_calls"));
9248            expected_keys.push(format!("{prefix}tool:read"));
9249        }
9250        let first = tokio::spawn(app.clone().oneshot(request()));
9251        tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(5), store.entered.notified())
9252            .await
9253            .unwrap();
9254        // This task must be scheduled while refund_many is still blocked.
9255        // Abort the caller at that point; the detached owner must finish
9256        // both ledger compensations before releasing its admission permit.
9257        let progressed_while_refund_waited = !store.fallback_used.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Acquire);
9258        let charged_before_release: Vec<_> =
9259            expected_keys.iter().map(|key| store.get(key).unwrap()).collect();
9260        first.abort();
9261        *store.released.lock() = true;
9262        store.wake.notify_all();
9263        let caller_cancelled = first.await.is_err_and(|error| error.is_cancelled());
9264        tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(5), state.mcp_inflight.wait_drained())
9265            .await
9266            .unwrap();
9267        let first_batches = store.batches.lock().clone();
9268        let after_first: Vec<_> = expected_keys.iter().map(|key| store.get(key).unwrap()).collect();
9269        let retry = app.oneshot(request()).await.unwrap();
9270        let retry_status = retry.status();
9271        tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(5), state.mcp_inflight.wait_drained())
9272            .await
9273            .unwrap();
9274        tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(5), state.worker.wait_idle())
9275            .await
9276            .unwrap();
9277        let batches = store.batches.lock().clone();
9278        let session = state.sessions.get("refund-cancel").unwrap();
9279
9280        assert!(
9281            progressed_while_refund_waited,
9282            "synchronous budget compensation blocked the only Tokio thread until the fallback released it"
9283        );
9284        assert!(
9285            charged_before_release.iter().all(|value| *value == 1),
9286            "both session and principal ledgers must actually be debited before compensation"
9287        );
9288        assert!(
9289            caller_cancelled,
9290            "the outer caller must be cancelled while compensation is in progress"
9291        );
9292        assert_eq!(
9293            first_batches.len(),
9294            2,
9295            "one session and one principal refund must complete despite cancellation"
9296        );
9297        assert!(
9298            after_first.iter().all(|value| *value == 0),
9299            "both ledgers must be refunded before retry"
9300        );
9301        assert_eq!(
9302            retry_status,
9303            StatusCode::BAD_GATEWAY,
9304            "retry must attempt the unexecuted call, not return a pending claim or spent-budget refusal"
9305        );
9306        assert_eq!(
9307            batches.len(),
9308            4,
9309            "each of two attempts refunds each ledger exactly once"
9310        );
9311        for key in expected_keys {
9312            let amounts: Vec<_> = batches
9313                .iter()
9314                .flatten()
9315                .filter(|refund| refund.key == key)
9316                .map(|refund| refund.amount)
9317                .collect();
9318            assert_eq!(amounts, [1, 1], "unexpected compensation for {key}");
9319            assert_eq!(store.get(&key).unwrap(), 0);
9320        }
9321        assert_eq!(state.mcp_admission.available_permits(), 1);
9322        assert_eq!(session.active_streams_count(), 0);
9323        assert_eq!(session.pending_jobs_count(), 0);
9324    }

9326    async fn assert_orphan_mcp_intent_refuses_startup(unaudited: bool) {
9327        let directory = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
9328        let (state, provider) = test_state(directory.path()).await;
9329        let session_id = "orphan-uncertain";
9330        let mut headers = HeaderMap::new();
9331        headers.insert("x-pv-session", HeaderValue::from_static("orphan-uncertain"));
9332        let body = br#"{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":"orphan","method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"read","arguments":{}}}"#;
9333        let mut execution =
9334            ToolExecution::from_request(&state.config.atif_spool_dir, &headers, body, state.journal_key)
9335                .unwrap();
9336        execution
9337            .bind_principal(&pv_events::AgentIdentity {
9338                version: "dev".to_owned(),
9339                charter: "anonymous".into(),
9340                instance_uid: "anonymous".to_owned(),
9341                ttl_remaining_s: None,
9342            })
9343            .unwrap();
9344        // This is a valid authenticated execution claim with no first journal
9345        // record. MCP authorization queues its worker job without waiting, so
9346        // claim() and the remote effect may precede that metadata commit.
9347        execution.claim().await.unwrap();
9348        if unaudited {
9349            execution
9350                .persist(&ToolOutcome {
9351                    status: 200,
9352                    body_hex: hex::encode(b"effect happened"),
9353                    content_type: Some("text/plain".to_owned()),
9354                })
9355                .await
9356                .unwrap();
9357        }
9358        let intent_before = std::fs::read(&execution.intent_path).unwrap();
9359        assert!(state.sessions.get(session_id).is_none());
9360        assert!(!std::fs::read_dir(directory.path())
9361            .unwrap()
9362            .filter_map(Result::ok)
9363            .any(|entry| entry.file_name().to_string_lossy().ends_with(".session.json")));
9364        let recovered = tokio::time::timeout(
9365            Duration::from_secs(5),
9366            state
9367                .finalizer
9368                .recover_spooled_sessions(&state.sessions, &state.config.breaker),
9369        )
9370        .await
9371        .unwrap();
9372        let mut minted_after_new_traffic = false;
9373        if recovered.is_ok() {
9374            // Main would start accepting traffic after this successful return.
9375            // A new chat with the same external ID must not manufacture a
9376            // clean trajectory that omits the earlier uncertain tool effect.
9377            let app = build_router(state.clone());
9378            let chat = app.clone().oneshot(chat_request(session_id)).await.unwrap();
9379            axum::body::to_bytes(chat.into_body(), 64 * 1024).await.unwrap();
9380            let _ = app
9381                .clone()
9382                .oneshot(
9383                    Request::builder()
9384                        .method("POST")
9385                        .uri("/v1/sessions/orphan-uncertain/close")
9386                        .body(Body::empty())
9387                        .unwrap(),
9388                )
9389                .await
9390                .unwrap();
9391            let _ = app
9392                .oneshot(
9393                    Request::builder()
9394                        .method("POST")
9395                        .uri("/v1/sessions/orphan-uncertain/promote")
9396                        .body(Body::empty())
9397                        .unwrap(),
9398                )
9399                .await
9400                .unwrap();
9401            tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(5), state.worker.wait_idle())
9402                .await
9403                .unwrap();
9404            minted_after_new_traffic = state
9405                .sessions
9406                .get(session_id)
9407                .is_some_and(|session| session.receipt.lock().is_some());
9408        }
9409        provider.abort();
9410        let _ = provider.await;
9411        assert!(!minted_after_new_traffic,
9412            "startup accepted an authenticated orphan intent, then new traffic minted a receipt omitting its uncertain effect");
9413        let error = recovered.expect_err(
9414            "an authenticated unresolved intent without recoverable session metadata must refuse startup",
9415        );
9416        assert!(error.to_string().contains("unresolved tool execution"));
9417        assert_eq!(std::fs::read(&execution.intent_path).unwrap(), intent_before);
9418        assert!(
9419            state.sessions.get(session_id).is_none(),
9420            "recovery must not invent session attribution"
9421        );
9422    }

9434    async fn assert_evicted_mcp_intent_refuses_receipt(workflow: &str) {
9435        let directory = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
9436        let (state, provider) = test_state(directory.path()).await;
9437        let session_id = "evicted-uncertain";
9438        let identity = pv_events::AgentIdentity {
9439            version: "dev".to_owned(),
9440            charter: "anonymous".into(),
9441            instance_uid: "anonymous".to_owned(),
9442            ttl_remaining_s: None,
9443        };
9444        let original = state.sessions.get_or_open(
9445            session_id,
9446            crate::session::Workflow::parse(workflow).unwrap(),
9447            &identity,
9448            &state.config.breaker,
9449        );
9450        let mut headers = HeaderMap::new();
9451        headers.insert("x-pv-session", HeaderValue::from_static("evicted-uncertain"));
9452        let body = br#"{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":"evicted","method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"read","arguments":{}}}"#;
9453        let mut execution =
9454            ToolExecution::from_request(&state.config.atif_spool_dir, &headers, body, state.journal_key)
9455                .unwrap();
9456        execution.bind_principal(&identity).unwrap();
9457        execution.claim().await.unwrap();
9458        let intent_before = std::fs::read(&execution.intent_path).unwrap();
9459        original.mark_capture_failed();
9460        // Deterministically model the existing retained-quarantine overflow
9461        // eviction, without constructing thousands of unrelated sessions.
9462        state.sessions.remove(session_id);
9463        let app = build_router(state.clone());
9464        let request = Request::builder()
9465            .method("POST")
9466            .uri("/v1/chat/completions")
9467            .header("content-type", "application/json")
9468            .header("x-pv-session", session_id)
9469            .header("x-pv-workflow", workflow)
9470            .body(Body::from(serde_json::to_vec(&chat_payload()).unwrap()))
9471            .unwrap();
9472        let chat = app.clone().oneshot(request).await.unwrap();
9473        assert_eq!(chat.status(), StatusCode::OK);
9474        axum::body::to_bytes(chat.into_body(), 64 * 1024).await.unwrap();
9475        tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(5), state.worker.wait_idle())
9476            .await
9477            .unwrap();
9478        let fresh = state.sessions.get(session_id).unwrap();
9479        assert!(!Arc::ptr_eq(&original, &fresh));
9480        assert!(
9481            !fresh.capture_failed(),
9482            "the durable guard cannot rely on the old RAM flag"
9483        );
9484        let close = app
9485            .clone()
9486            .oneshot(
9487                Request::builder()
9488                    .method("POST")
9489                    .uri("/v1/sessions/evicted-uncertain/close")
9490                    .body(Body::empty())
9491                    .unwrap(),
9492            )
9493            .await
9494            .unwrap()
9495            .status();
9496        let promote = app
9497            .oneshot(
9498                Request::builder()
9499                    .method("POST")
9500                    .uri("/v1/sessions/evicted-uncertain/promote")
9501                    .body(Body::empty())
9502                    .unwrap(),
9503            )
9504            .await
9505            .unwrap()
9506            .status();
9507        provider.abort();
9508        let _ = provider.await;
9509        assert!(
9510            fresh.receipt.lock().is_none(),
9511            "evicting the RAM quarantine must not permit a receipt omitting the durable uncertain effect"
9512        );
9513        assert_eq!(close, StatusCode::SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE);
9514        assert!(!promote.is_success());
9515        assert_eq!(std::fs::read(&execution.intent_path).unwrap(), intent_before);
9516        assert!(
9517            !fresh.capture_failed(),
9518            "the durable refusal must preserve retryable audit completion"
9519        );
9520    }

9668        std::fs::write(&execution_dir, evidence).unwrap();

9677        let retained = std::fs::read(&execution_dir).unwrap() == evidence;
9678        let issued_on_failure = session.receipt.lock().is_some() || session.atif_path.lock().is_some();
9679        let retryable = !session.capture_failed() && !session.is_closed();
9680        std::fs::remove_file(&execution_dir).unwrap();
9681        let repaired = app.oneshot(close_request()).await.unwrap().status();
9682        provider.abort();
9683        let _ = provider.await;
9684        assert_eq!(failed, StatusCode::SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE);
9685        assert!(retained);
9686        assert!(!issued_on_failure);
9687        assert!(retryable);
9688        assert_eq!(repaired, StatusCode::OK);
9689    }

9691    #[test]
9692    fn mcp_durable_readonly_scan_preserves_evidence_on_cap_and_authentication_errors() {
9693        let directory = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
9694        for name in ["one.evidence", "two.evidence", "three.evidence"] {
9695            std::fs::write(directory.path().join(name), b"retained evidence").unwrap();
9696        }
9697        let capped = ensure_tool_executions_resolved_with_limit(directory.path(), "session", &[7; 32], 2);
9698        assert!(capped.unwrap_err().contains("bounded scan limit"));
9699        for name in ["one.evidence", "two.evidence", "three.evidence"] {
9700            assert_eq!(
9701                std::fs::read(directory.path().join(name)).unwrap(),
9702                b"retained evidence"
9703            );
9704        }
9705        // An intent listed and then archived by another session's close
9706        // (here: a dangling link, which reads as not found) is skipped.
9707        #[cfg(unix)]
9708        {
9709            std::os::unix::fs::symlink(
9710                directory.path().join("archived-elsewhere"),
9711                directory.path().join("gone.intent.json"),
9712            )
9713            .unwrap();
9714            let skipped =
9715                ensure_tool_executions_resolved_with_limit(directory.path(), "session", &[7; 32], 10);
9716            assert!(skipped.is_ok(), "{skipped:?}");
9717            std::fs::remove_file(directory.path().join("gone.intent.json")).unwrap();
9718        }
9719        let writing_claim = directory.path().join("partial.intent.json");
9720        std::fs::write(&writing_claim, b"unfinished concurrent claim").unwrap();
9721        let unauthenticated =
9722            ensure_tool_executions_resolved_with_limit(directory.path(), "session", &[7; 32], 10);
9723        assert!(unauthenticated.unwrap_err().contains("authenticated"));
9724        assert_eq!(
9725            std::fs::read(writing_claim).unwrap(),
9726            b"unfinished concurrent claim"
9727        );
9728        assert_eq!(
9729            std::fs::read_dir(directory.path()).unwrap().count(),
9730            4,
9731            "the lifecycle scan must never rename or delete another live request's incomplete files"
9732        );
9733    }

9735    struct WithheldHeadersToolState {
9736        effects: std::sync::atomic::AtomicUsize,
9737        release: tokio::sync::Notify,
9738        returned: std::sync::atomic::AtomicBool,
9739        terminated: std::sync::atomic::AtomicBool,
9740    }
9741
9742    struct WithheldHeadersGuard(Arc<WithheldHeadersToolState>);
9743
9744    impl Drop for WithheldHeadersGuard {
9745        fn drop(&mut self) {
9746            self.0
9747                .terminated
9748                .store(true, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Release);
9749        }
9750    }
9751
9752    async fn tool_effect_before_headers(State(state): State<Arc<WithheldHeadersToolState>>) -> Response {
9753        let _guard = WithheldHeadersGuard(Arc::clone(&state));
9754        // The request has crossed the remote execution boundary, but the
9755        // gateway has received no HTTP status or response headers yet.
9756        state.effects.fetch_add(1, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::AcqRel);
9757        let _ = tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(6), state.release.notified()).await;
9758        state.returned.store(true, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Release);
9759        Json(json!({"ok": true})).into_response()
9760    }
9761
9762    async fn assert_mcp_header_deadline(workflow: &str, cancel_caller: bool, restart: bool) {
9763        let directory = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
9764        let listener = tokio::net::TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").await.unwrap();
9765        let address = listener.local_addr().unwrap();
9766        let observed = Arc::new(WithheldHeadersToolState {
9767            effects: std::sync::atomic::AtomicUsize::new(0),
9768            release: tokio::sync::Notify::new(),
9769            returned: std::sync::atomic::AtomicBool::new(false),
9770            terminated: std::sync::atomic::AtomicBool::new(false),
9771        });
9772        let tool = Router::new()
9773            .route("/mcp", post(tool_effect_before_headers))
9774            .with_state(Arc::clone(&observed));
9775        let server = tokio::spawn(async move { axum::serve(listener, tool).await.unwrap() });
9776        let mut config = crate::config::HarnessConfig::for_tests(
9777            &format!("http://{address}"),
9778            &directory.path().to_string_lossy(),
9779            &directory.path().to_string_lossy(),
9780        );
9781        config.default_workflow = workflow.to_owned();
9782        config.tool_upstream_url = Some(format!("http://{address}/mcp"));
9783        // A long read-idle timeout isolates the shorter MCP total deadline.
9784        config.upstream_read_timeout_s = Some(10);
9785        config.mcp_request_timeout_s = Some(1);
9786        config.mcp_concurrency = 1;
9787        config.budget.max_total_tool_calls = Some(2);
9788        config.budget.max_tool_calls.insert("read".into(), 2);
9789        config.principal_budget = Some(config.budget.clone());
9790        config.allow_anonymous_principal_budget = true;
9791        let make_state = |store: Arc<InMemoryStore>| {
9792            AppState::new(
9793                config.clone(),
9794                store,
9795                Arc::new(
9796                    Sandbox::new(
9797                        SandboxConfig {
9798                            budget: config.budget.clone(),
9799                            ..SandboxConfig::default()
9800                        },
9801                        Vec::new(),
9802                    )
9803                    .unwrap(),
9804                ),
9805                Arc::new(NullBus),
9806                None,
9807                Arc::new(Ed25519Signer::from_seed(&[11; 32])),
9808            )
9809            .unwrap()
9810        };
9811        let store = Arc::new(InMemoryStore::new());
9812        let state = make_state(Arc::clone(&store));
9813        let app = build_router(state.clone());
9814        let body = br#"{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":"headers","method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"read","arguments":{}}}"#;
9815        let request = || {
9816            Request::builder()
9817                .method("POST")
9818                .uri("/v1/mcp")
9819                .header("content-type", "application/json")
9820                .header("x-pv-session", "withheld-headers")
9821                .body(Body::from(Bytes::from_static(body)))
9822                .unwrap()
9823        };
9824        let first = tokio::spawn(app.clone().oneshot(request()));
9825        tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(5), async {
9826            while observed.effects.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Acquire) == 0 {
9827                tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10)).await;
9828            }
9829        })
9830        .await
9831        .unwrap();
9832        if cancel_caller {
9833            first.abort();
9834        }
9835        tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(5), state.mcp_inflight.wait_drained())
9836            .await
9837            .unwrap();
9838        let first_status = if cancel_caller {
9839            assert!(first.await.unwrap_err().is_cancelled());
9840            None
9841        } else {
9842            Some(first.await.unwrap().unwrap().status())
9843        };
9844        assert!(!observed.returned.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Acquire));
9845        let retry = app.clone().oneshot(request()).await.unwrap();
9846        let retry_status = retry.status();
9847        let retry_body = axum::body::to_bytes(retry.into_body(), 64 * 1024).await.unwrap();
9848        tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(5), state.worker.wait_idle())
9849            .await
9850            .unwrap();
9851        let session = state.sessions.get("withheld-headers").unwrap();
9852        let mut headers = HeaderMap::new();
9853        headers.insert("x-pv-session", HeaderValue::from_static("withheld-headers"));
9854        let mut execution =
9855            ToolExecution::from_request(&state.config.atif_spool_dir, &headers, body, state.journal_key)
9856                .unwrap();
9857        execution.bind_principal(&session.current_identity()).unwrap();
9858        assert!(matches!(
9859            execution.load().await.unwrap(),
9860            ToolExecutionState::Pending
9861        ));
9862        assert!(execution.intent_path.exists());
9863        assert!(!execution.outcome_path.exists());
9864        assert!(!execution.audited_path.exists());
9865        for prefix in [
9866            pv_state::ActionBudget::session_prefix("withheld-headers"),
9867            pv_state::ActionBudget::principal_prefix("anonymous"),
9868        ] {
9869            for suffix in ["total_calls", "tool:read"] {
9870                assert_eq!(
9871                    store.get(&format!("{prefix}{suffix}")).unwrap(),
9872                    1,
9873                    "uncertain execution must retain its charge without charging the refused retry"
9874                );
9875            }
9876        }
9877        assert_eq!(state.mcp_inflight.count(), 0);
9878        assert_eq!(state.mcp_admission.available_permits(), 1);
9879        assert_eq!(session.active_streams_count(), 0);
9880        assert_eq!(session.pending_jobs_count(), 0);
9881        drop(session);
9882        drop(app);
9883        // A fresh registry and store ensure recovery uses authenticated disk
9884        // evidence, not the old in-memory session or a spent quota.
9885        let lifecycle_state = if restart {
9886            drop(state);
9887            let recovered = make_state(Arc::new(InMemoryStore::new()));
9888            recovered
9889                .finalizer
9890                .recover_spooled_sessions(&recovered.sessions, &recovered.config.breaker)
9891                .await
9892                .unwrap();
9893            assert!(recovered
9894                .sessions
9895                .get("withheld-headers")
9896                .unwrap()
9897                .capture_failed());
9898            recovered
9899        } else {
9900            state
9901        };
9902        let lifecycle_app = build_router(lifecycle_state.clone());
9903        let replay = lifecycle_app.clone().oneshot(request()).await.unwrap();
9904        let replay_status = replay.status();
9905        let close = lifecycle_app
9906            .clone()
9907            .oneshot(
9908                Request::builder()
9909                    .method("POST")
9910                    .uri("/v1/sessions/withheld-headers/close")
9911                    .body(Body::empty())
9912                    .unwrap(),
9913            )
9914            .await
9915            .unwrap();
9916        let close_status = close.status();
9917        let close_body = axum::body::to_bytes(close.into_body(), 64 * 1024).await.unwrap();
9918        let promote = lifecycle_app
9919            .clone()
9920            .oneshot(
9921                Request::builder()
9922                    .method("POST")
9923                    .uri("/v1/sessions/withheld-headers/promote")
9924                    .body(Body::empty())
9925                    .unwrap(),
9926            )
9927            .await
9928            .unwrap();
9929        let promote_status = promote.status();
9930        tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(5), lifecycle_state.worker.wait_idle())
9931            .await
9932            .unwrap();
9933        let session = lifecycle_state.sessions.get("withheld-headers").unwrap();
9934        let receipt_minted = session.receipt.lock().is_some();
9935        let retained_intent_after_close = execution.intent_path.exists();
9936        let retry_after_close = lifecycle_app.clone().oneshot(request()).await.unwrap().status();
9937        drop(session);
9938        drop(lifecycle_app);
9939        drop(lifecycle_state);
9940        let recovered_again = make_state(Arc::new(InMemoryStore::new()));
9941        tokio::time::timeout(
9942            Duration::from_secs(5),
9943            recovered_again
9944                .finalizer
9945                .recover_spooled_sessions(&recovered_again.sessions, &recovered_again.config.breaker),
9946        )
9947        .await
9948        .unwrap()
9949        .unwrap();
9950        let session = recovered_again.sessions.get("withheld-headers").unwrap();
9951        let still_quarantined = session.capture_failed();
9952        let recovered_receipt = session.receipt.lock().is_some();
9953        let recovered_app = build_router(recovered_again.clone());
9954        let retry_after_restart = recovered_app.clone().oneshot(request()).await.unwrap().status();
9955        let close_after_restart = recovered_app
9956            .clone()
9957            .oneshot(
9958                Request::builder()
9959                    .method("POST")
9960                    .uri("/v1/sessions/withheld-headers/close")
9961                    .body(Body::empty())
9962                    .unwrap(),
9963            )
9964            .await
9965            .unwrap();
9966        let close_after_restart_status = close_after_restart.status();
9967        let close_after_restart_body = axum::body::to_bytes(close_after_restart.into_body(), 64 * 1024)
9968            .await
9969            .unwrap();
9970        let promote_after_restart = recovered_app
9971            .oneshot(
9972                Request::builder()
9973                    .method("POST")
9974                    .uri("/v1/sessions/withheld-headers/promote")
9975                    .body(Body::empty())
9976                    .unwrap(),
9977            )
9978            .await
9979            .unwrap()
9980            .status();
9981        tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(5), recovered_again.worker.wait_idle())
9982            .await
9983            .unwrap();
9984        // Release the real remote handler and drain it even on the failing
9985        // pre-fix lifecycle path before asserting the final outcomes.
9986        observed.release.notify_one();
9987        tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(2), async {
9988            while !observed.terminated.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Acquire) {
9989                tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10)).await;
9990            }
9991        })
9992        .await
9993        .unwrap();
9994        server.abort();
9995        let _ = server.await;
9996
9997        if let Some(status) = first_status {
9998            assert_eq!(status, StatusCode::BAD_GATEWAY);
9999        }
10000        assert_eq!(retry_status, StatusCode::CONFLICT);
10001        assert!(String::from_utf8_lossy(&retry_body).contains(TOOL_OUTCOME_UNCERTAIN));
10002        assert_eq!(replay_status, StatusCode::CONFLICT);
10003        assert_eq!(observed.effects.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Acquire), 1);
10004        assert!(
10005            !receipt_minted,
10006            "uncertain tool execution must never mint a complete receipt"
10007        );
10008        assert_eq!(promote_status, StatusCode::CONFLICT);
10009        assert!(
10010            retained_intent_after_close,
10011            "closing a quarantine must retain the authenticated uncertain intent"
10012        );
10013        assert_eq!(retry_after_close, StatusCode::CONFLICT);
10014        assert!(
10015            still_quarantined,
10016            "quarantine must survive closing and another restart"
10017        );
10018        assert!(
10019            !recovered_receipt,
10020            "restart must not turn an uncertain execution into a complete receipt"
10021        );
10022        assert_eq!(retry_after_restart, StatusCode::CONFLICT);
10023        assert_eq!(promote_after_restart, StatusCode::CONFLICT);
10024        if close_after_restart_status == StatusCode::OK {
10025            assert_eq!(
10026                serde_json::from_slice::<Value>(&close_after_restart_body).unwrap(),
10027                json!({"kind": "already_closed"})
10028            );
10029        } else {
10030            assert_eq!(close_after_restart_status, StatusCode::CONFLICT);
10031        }
10032        assert!(session.receipt.lock().is_none());
10033        assert!(session.atif_path.lock().is_none());
10034        // A recovered quarantine may already be closed. Its idempotent close
10035        // can acknowledge that fact, but cannot return an ATIF or receipt.
10036        if restart && close_status == StatusCode::OK {
10037            assert_eq!(
10038                serde_json::from_slice::<Value>(&close_body).unwrap(),
10039                json!({"kind": "already_closed"})
10040            );
10041        } else {
10042            assert_eq!(close_status, StatusCode::CONFLICT);
10043        }
10044    }

10217    async fn mcp_quarantine_retains_only_unresolved_execution_evidence() {

10221        let opened = app.clone().oneshot(chat_request("retention")).await.unwrap();
10222        assert_eq!(opened.status(), StatusCode::OK);
10223        axum::body::to_bytes(opened.into_body(), 64 * 1024).await.unwrap();
10224        tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(5), state.worker.wait_idle())
10225            .await
10226            .unwrap();
10227        let session = state.sessions.get("retention").unwrap();
10228        let mut headers = HeaderMap::new();
10229        headers.insert("x-pv-session", HeaderValue::from_static("retention"));
10230        let outcome = ToolOutcome {
10231            status: 502,
10232            body_hex: hex::encode(b"partial failure evidence"),
10233            content_type: Some("text/plain".to_owned()),
10234        };
10235        let mut executions = Vec::new();
10236        for kind in [
10237            "pending",
10238            "unaudited",
10239            "corrupt-outcome",
10240            "corrupt-audit",
10241            "completed",
10242        ] {
10243            let body = serde_json::to_vec(&json!({
10244                "jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": kind, "method": "tools/call",
10245                "params": {"name": "read", "arguments": {}}
10246            }))
10247            .unwrap();
10248            let mut execution =
10249                ToolExecution::from_request(&state.config.atif_spool_dir, &headers, &body, state.journal_key)
10250                    .unwrap();
10251            execution.bind_principal(&session.current_identity()).unwrap();
10252            execution.claim().await.unwrap();
10253            if kind != "pending" {
10254                execution.persist(&outcome).await.unwrap();
10255            }
10256            if matches!(kind, "completed" | "corrupt-outcome" | "corrupt-audit") {
10257                execution.mark_audited().await.unwrap();
10258            }
10259            if kind == "corrupt-outcome" {
10260                std::fs::write(&execution.outcome_path, b"not an authenticated outcome").unwrap();
10261            }
10262            if kind == "corrupt-audit" {
10263                std::fs::write(&execution.audited_path, b"not an authenticated audit marker").unwrap();
10264            }
10265            let intent_before = std::fs::read(&execution.intent_path).unwrap();
10266            let outcome_before = std::fs::read(&execution.outcome_path).ok();
10267            executions.push((kind, execution, intent_before, outcome_before));
10268        }
10269        session.mark_capture_failed();
10270        let refused = app
10271            .clone()
10272            .oneshot(
10273                Request::builder()
10274                    .method("POST")
10275                    .uri("/v1/sessions/retention/close")
10276                    .body(Body::empty())
10277                    .unwrap(),
10278            )
10279            .await
10280            .unwrap()
10281            .status();
10282        // One quarantined session must not stop another valid session from
10283        // capturing, closing and issuing its own complete receipt.
10284        let other = app.clone().oneshot(chat_request("other-complete")).await.unwrap();
10285        let other_status = other.status();
10286        axum::body::to_bytes(other.into_body(), 64 * 1024).await.unwrap();
10287        let other_close = app
10288            .clone()
10289            .oneshot(
10290                Request::builder()
10291                    .method("POST")
10292                    .uri("/v1/sessions/other-complete/close")
10293                    .body(Body::empty())
10294                    .unwrap(),
10295            )
10296            .await
10297            .unwrap()
10298            .status();
10299        let other_promote = app
10300            .oneshot(
10301                Request::builder()
10302                    .method("POST")
10303                    .uri("/v1/sessions/other-complete/promote")
10304                    .body(Body::empty())
10305                    .unwrap(),
10306            )
10307            .await
10308            .unwrap()
10309            .status();
10310        tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(5), state.worker.wait_idle())
10311            .await
10312            .unwrap();
10313        provider.abort();
10314        let _ = provider.await;
10315        assert_eq!(refused, StatusCode::CONFLICT);
10316        assert!(session.receipt.lock().is_none());
10317        assert_eq!(other_status, StatusCode::OK);
10318        assert_eq!(other_close, StatusCode::OK);
10319        assert_eq!(other_promote, StatusCode::OK);
10320        for (kind, execution, intent_before, outcome_before) in executions {
10321            if kind == "completed" {
10322                assert!(!execution.intent_path.exists());
10323                assert!(!execution.outcome_path.exists());
10324                assert!(!execution.audited_path.exists());
10325                let archived_intent = std::fs::read_dir(execution.intent_path.parent().unwrap())
10326                    .unwrap()
10327                    .filter_map(Result::ok)
10328                    .find(|entry| {
10329                        entry
10330                            .file_name()
10331                            .to_string_lossy()
10332                            .starts_with(&format!("{}.intent.json.capturefailed-", execution.key))
10333                    })
10334                    .expect("completed evidence must be archived, not deleted");
10335                assert_eq!(std::fs::read(archived_intent.path()).unwrap(), intent_before);
10336            } else {
10337                assert_eq!(
10338                    std::fs::read(&execution.intent_path).unwrap(),
10339                    intent_before,
10340                    "{kind} must retain its authenticated primary intent"
10341                );
10342                assert_eq!(
10343                    std::fs::read(&execution.outcome_path).ok(),
10344                    outcome_before,
10345                    "{kind} must preserve all partial outcome evidence"
10346                );
10347            }
10348        }
10349    }

10351    async fn slow_active_chat() -> Response {
10352        let frames = futures::stream::unfold(0u8, |index| async move {
10353            if index == 7 {
10354                return None;
10355            }
10356            if index != 0 {
10357                tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(250)).await;
10358            }
10359            let frame = if index == 6 {
10360                format!(
10361                    "data: {}\n\ndata: [DONE]\n\n",
10362                    json!({
10363                        "choices": [{"index": 0, "delta": {}, "finish_reason": "stop"}],
10364                        "usage": {"prompt_tokens": 2, "completion_tokens": 6}
10365                    })
10366                )
10367            } else {
10368                // Each frame exceeds the capture threshold and arrives well
10369                // before the one-second read-idle deadline.
10370                format!(
10371                    "data: {}\n\n",
10372                    json!({
10373                        "choices": [{"index": 0, "delta": {"content": format!("chat exceeds MCP {}", "x".repeat(280))}, "finish_reason": null}]
10374                    })
10375                )
10376            };
10377            Some((Ok::<_, std::convert::Infallible>(Bytes::from(frame)), index + 1))
10378        });
10379        let mut response = Response::new(Body::from_stream(frames));
10380        response.headers_mut().insert(
10381            axum::http::header::CONTENT_TYPE,
10382            HeaderValue::from_static("text/event-stream"),
10383        );
10384        response
10385    }

10388    async fn mcp_total_deadline_does_not_limit_active_chat_streams() {
10389        let directory = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();

10400        config.mcp_request_timeout_s = Some(1);
10401        let state = AppState::new(

10404            Arc::new(Sandbox::new(SandboxConfig::default(), Vec::new()).unwrap()),

10442    struct SlowDripToolState {
10443        calls: std::sync::atomic::AtomicUsize,
10444        chunks: std::sync::atomic::AtomicUsize,
10445        dropped: std::sync::atomic::AtomicBool,
10446    }
10447
10448    struct SlowDripBodyGuard(Arc<SlowDripToolState>);
10449
10450    impl Drop for SlowDripBodyGuard {
10451        fn drop(&mut self) {
10452            self.0.dropped.store(true, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Release);
10453        }
10454    }
10455
10456    async fn slow_drip_tool(State(state): State<Arc<SlowDripToolState>>) -> Response {
10457        state.calls.fetch_add(1, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::AcqRel);
10458        // A finite three-second response keeps the one-second idle timer
10459        // alive. Keeping this finite also makes the pre-fix regression safe
10460        // to run: detached MCP work can drain before its spool is deleted.
10461        let chunks = futures::stream::unfold((0u8, SlowDripBodyGuard(state)), |(index, guard)| async move {
10462            if index == 16 {
10463                return None;
10464            }
10465            if index != 0 {
10466                tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(200)).await;
10467            }
10468            let bytes = match index {
10469                0 => Bytes::from_static(b"{\"ok\":"),
10470                15 => Bytes::from_static(b"true}"),
10471                _ => Bytes::from_static(b" "),
10472            };
10473            guard.0.chunks.fetch_add(1, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::AcqRel);
10474            Some((Ok::<_, std::convert::Infallible>(bytes), (index + 1, guard)))
10475        });
10476        let mut response = Response::new(Body::from_stream(chunks));
10477        response.headers_mut().insert(
10478            axum::http::header::CONTENT_TYPE,
10479            HeaderValue::from_static("application/json"),
10480        );
10481        response
10482    }

10484    async fn assert_mcp_slow_drip_deadline(cancel_caller: bool) {
10485        let directory = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
10486        let listener = tokio::net::TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").await.unwrap();
10487        let address = listener.local_addr().unwrap();
10488        let observed = Arc::new(SlowDripToolState {
10489            calls: std::sync::atomic::AtomicUsize::new(0),
10490            chunks: std::sync::atomic::AtomicUsize::new(0),
10491            dropped: std::sync::atomic::AtomicBool::new(false),
10492        });
10493        let tool = Router::new()
10494            .route("/mcp", post(slow_drip_tool))
10495            .with_state(Arc::clone(&observed));
10496        let server = tokio::spawn(async move { axum::serve(listener, tool).await.unwrap() });
10497        let mut config = crate::config::HarnessConfig::for_tests(
10498            &format!("http://{address}"),
10499            &directory.path().to_string_lossy(),
10500            &directory.path().to_string_lossy(),
10501        );
10502        config.tool_upstream_url = Some(format!("http://{address}/mcp"));
10503        config.upstream_read_timeout_s = Some(1);
10504        config.mcp_request_timeout_s = Some(1);
10505        config.mcp_concurrency = 1;
10506        let state = AppState::new(
10507            config,
10508            Arc::new(InMemoryStore::new()),
10509            Arc::new(Sandbox::new(SandboxConfig::default(), Vec::new()).unwrap()),
10510            Arc::new(NullBus),
10511            None,
10512            Arc::new(Ed25519Signer::from_seed(&[11; 32])),
10513        )
10514        .unwrap();
10515        let app = build_router(state.clone());
10516        let body = br#"{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":"slow-drip","method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"read","arguments":{}}}"#;
10517        let request = || {
10518            Request::builder()
10519                .method("POST")
10520                .uri("/v1/mcp")
10521                .header("content-type", "application/json")
10522                .header("x-pv-session", "slow-drip")
10523                .body(Body::from(Bytes::from_static(body)))
10524                .unwrap()
10525        };
10526        let first = tokio::spawn(app.clone().oneshot(request()));
10527        tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(5), async {
10528            while observed.chunks.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Acquire) < 2 {
10529                tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10)).await;
10530            }
10531        })
10532        .await
10533        .unwrap();
10534        if cancel_caller {
10535            first.abort();
10536        }
10537        // The intentionally detached audit owner must finish even when the
10538        // caller disappears. Do not delete its spool before it has drained.
10539        tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(5), state.mcp_inflight.wait_drained())
10540            .await
10541            .unwrap();
10542        let first_status = if cancel_caller {
10543            assert!(first.await.unwrap_err().is_cancelled());
10544            None
10545        } else {
10546            Some(first.await.unwrap().unwrap().status())
10547        };
10548        let retry = app.oneshot(request()).await.unwrap();
10549        let retry_status = retry.status();
10550        let retry_body = axum::body::to_bytes(retry.into_body(), 64 * 1024).await.unwrap();
10551        tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(5), state.worker.wait_idle())
10552            .await
10553            .unwrap();
10554        let session = state.sessions.get("slow-drip").unwrap();
10555        let mut headers = HeaderMap::new();
10556        headers.insert("x-pv-session", HeaderValue::from_static("slow-drip"));
10557        let mut execution =
10558            ToolExecution::from_request(&state.config.atif_spool_dir, &headers, body, state.journal_key)
10559                .unwrap();
10560        execution.bind_principal(&session.current_identity()).unwrap();
10561        let audited = matches!(execution.load().await.unwrap(), ToolExecutionState::Completed(_));
10562        let upstream_dropped = tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(2), async {
10563            while !observed.dropped.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Acquire) {
10564                tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10)).await;
10565            }
10566        })
10567        .await
10568        .is_ok();
10569        server.abort();
10570        let _ = server.await;
10571
10572        assert_eq!(
10573            retry_status,
10574            StatusCode::BAD_GATEWAY,
10575            "the total deadline must terminate a response that never exceeds the idle timeout"
10576        );
10577        if let Some(status) = first_status {
10578            assert_eq!(status, retry_status, "the retry must replay the original failure");
10579        }
10580        assert!(String::from_utf8_lossy(&retry_body).contains("response could not be read"));
10581        assert_eq!(
10582            observed.calls.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Acquire),
10583            1,
10584            "retry must not repeat tool effects"
10585        );
10586        assert!(
10587            observed.chunks.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Acquire) < 16,
10588            "the upstream response must be dropped before its finite completion"
10589        );
10590        assert!(upstream_dropped, "timing out must release the upstream body");
10591        assert!(audited, "the timeout outcome must carry its durable audit marker");
10592        assert_eq!(state.mcp_inflight.count(), 0);
10593        assert_eq!(state.mcp_admission.available_permits(), 1);
10594        assert_eq!(session.active_streams_count(), 0);
10595        assert_eq!(session.pending_jobs_count(), 0);
10596    }

10643    #[tokio::test]
10644    async fn concurrent_duplicate_tool_claims_conflict_without_leaking_io_detail() {
10645        let tool_listener = tokio::net::TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").await.unwrap();
10646        let tool_address = tool_listener.local_addr().unwrap();
10647        let held = Arc::new(HeldToolState {
10648            arrived: std::sync::atomic::AtomicBool::new(false),
10649            release: tokio::sync::Notify::new(),
10650        });
10651        let tool_router = Router::new()
10652            .route("/mcp", post(held_tool))
10653            .with_state(Arc::clone(&held));
10654        let tool_server = tokio::spawn(async move {
10655            axum::serve(tool_listener, tool_router).await.unwrap();
10656        });
10657        let directory = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
10658        let (mut state, provider) = test_state(directory.path()).await;
10659        Arc::get_mut(&mut state.config).unwrap().tool_upstream_url =
10660            Some(format!("http://{tool_address}/mcp"));
10661        let app = build_router(state);
10662        let request = || {
10663            Request::builder()
10664                .method("POST")
10665                .uri("/v1/mcp")
10666                .header("x-pv-session", "claim-race")
10667                .body(Body::from(
10668                    r#"{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":7,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"read","arguments":{}}}"#,
10669                ))
10670                .unwrap()
10671        };
10672        let winner_app = app.clone();
10673        let winner = tokio::spawn(async move { winner_app.oneshot(request()).await.unwrap() });
10674        tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(1), async {
10675            while !held.arrived.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Acquire) {
10676                tokio::task::yield_now().await;
10677            }
10678        })
10679        .await
10680        .unwrap();
10681        // The winner holds the claim while its upstream call is in flight;
10682        // an identical duplicate must lose the race with the canonical
10683        // uncertainty message and no io/filesystem detail.
10684        let loser = app.oneshot(request()).await.unwrap();
10685        assert_eq!(loser.status(), StatusCode::CONFLICT);
10686        let body = axum::body::to_bytes(loser.into_body(), 64 * 1024).await.unwrap();
10687        let text = String::from_utf8(body.to_vec()).unwrap();
10688        assert!(text.contains(TOOL_OUTCOME_UNCERTAIN), "{text}");
10689        assert!(!text.contains("os error"), "leaked io detail: {text}");
10690        held.release.notify_one();
10691        assert_eq!(winner.await.unwrap().status(), StatusCode::OK);
10692        tool_server.abort();
10693        provider.abort();
10694    }

10697    async fn close_waits_for_tool_execution_and_completion_capture() {

10699        let tool_address = tool_listener.local_addr().unwrap();

10707        let tool_server = tokio::spawn(async move {

10709        });

10712        Arc::get_mut(&mut state.config).unwrap().tool_upstream_url =
10713            Some(format!("http://{tool_address}/mcp"));
10714        let app = build_router(state);
10715        let tool_app = app.clone();
10716        let tool_task = tokio::spawn(async move {
10717            tool_app
10718                .oneshot(
10719                    Request::builder()
10720                        .method("POST")
10721                        .uri("/v1/mcp")
10722                        .header("x-pv-session", "held-tool")
10723                        .body(Body::from(
10724                            r#"{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":9,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"read","arguments":{}}}"#,
10725                        ))
10726                        .unwrap(),
10727                )
10728                .await
10729                .unwrap()
10730        });
10731        tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(1), async {
10732            while !held.arrived.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Acquire) {
10733                tokio::task::yield_now().await;
10734            }
10735        })
10736        .await
10737        .unwrap();
10738        let close_task = tokio::spawn(async move {
10739            app.oneshot(
10740                Request::builder()
10741                    .method("POST")

10753        let close_response = close_task.await.unwrap();
10754        let close_status = close_response.status();
10755        let close_body = axum::body::to_bytes(close_response.into_body(), 64 * 1024)
10756            .await
10757            .unwrap();
10758        assert_eq!(
10759            close_status,
10760            StatusCode::OK,
10761            "close failed: {}",
10762            String::from_utf8_lossy(&close_body)
10763        );
10764        tool_server.abort();
10765        provider.abort();
10766    }
